text:

[Setting]
Name: Watchtower
Category: Outside Tower
Description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
Background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

[Characters]
Court Wizard, Soldier

[Personas]
- I am an advisor of anything magical. I sell spells to those who need them. I am wealthy and hold an important place in political life
- I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.

[Objects]
Alarm Horn

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 2

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Court Wizard: A quiet night this evening...
[Turn 1] Soldier: yes it is
[Turn 2] Court Wizard: Have any else come up this eve? I had hoped for a quiet night to examine the stars (emote=ponder)
[Turn 3] Soldier: Yes, a few came through, but it is a cold night for me, I am used to warmer weather (emote=nod)
[Turn 4] Court Wizard: Well, you are but a common soldier.  No doubt you are used to such a lot.  Thankfully I have my spells to keep me warm. (emote=sigh)
[Turn 5] Soldier: I am a soldier doing my job (emote=grin)
[Turn 6] Court Wizard: Yes... well... Very well then.  See that you do!  No slacking off while your betters are about.
[Turn 7] Soldier: No sir
[Turn 8] Court Wizard: When, for example, was this horn last tested?  It looks dented.  How can we be sure it will work?
[Turn 9] Soldier: A year ago, Test it out or cause a need to use it
[Turn 10] Court Wizard: Mayhap I will speak to the king about such lackness.  Or perhaps I can sell him a spell that will serve just as well. (emote=frown)
[Turn 11] Soldier: Good idea, I agree, go do that (action=hug court wizard)
[Turn 12] Court Wizard: Get off of me, you fool!  Who gave you permission to touch me! (action=hit soldier)
[Turn 13] Soldier: To the jail with you (action=hit court wizard)

title: King episode in Dungeon
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_000003
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Dungeon
Category: Inside Castle
Description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
Background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

[Characters]
Guard, Prisoner

[Personas]
- I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.
- I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

[Objects]
Torch, Cell, Wall, Bar

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 4

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Guard: You, prisoner. The king wishes to see you. (emote=frown)
[Turn 1] Prisoner: What for?
[Turn 2] Guard: The king wishes to make a deal with you. Beyond me why he cares for a prisoner.
[Turn 3] Prisoner: Thank heavens, I thought I would never see my family again.
[Turn 4] Guard: Don't be so hasty. The king might ask more of you than you think.
[Turn 5] Prisoner: At least I'll have a chance to explain myself.
[Turn 6] Guard: You do that. But remember you were put in the dungeon for good cause.
[Turn 7] Prisoner: I was placed here by mistake. They have me mixed up with another man!
[Turn 8] Guard: They all tell me that. But this isn't my decision.
[Turn 9] Prisoner: I understand. You are only doing your job.
[Turn 10] Guard: At least you are cooperating. I'll mention that. (emote=nod)
[Turn 11] Prisoner: What have I been accused of doing?
[Turn 12] Guard: You are accused of disobeying a direct order by the queen. As rigid as she is.
[Turn 13] Prisoner: I don't remember being ordered by the queen to do anything. (emote=ponder)

title: King episode in Master Bedroom
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_000004
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Master Bedroom
Category: Inside Palace
Description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
Background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

[Characters]
Archer, King

[Personas]
- I am the king of this country and have been so ever since my father was killed in a riding accident.  I am frequently bored and aloof toward my country's affairs.  I prefer to spend my time drinking wine and chasing handmaidens.
- I am an archer. My weapon of choice is a bow and arrow. I'm very skillful and shooting a bow and arrow.

[Objects]


[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 9

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: What are you doing here, archer?
[Turn 1] Archer: An archer such as myself needs no reason to be at a nice place like this. 
[Turn 2] King: Since you are here, I need more wine. Please fill my glass immediately.
[Turn 3] Archer: Yes sir, although you're under utilizing my ability with a bow and and arrow. What a lovely place you have here.
[Turn 4] King: Thank you. My bed frame alone is more valuable than anything you've ever seen
[Turn 5] Archer: A frame made from materials more valuable than my bow. Where would one acquire such a material?
[Turn 6] King: That I cannot say. What do you hunt with your bow and arrow?
[Turn 7] Archer: I hunt the enemy. I deal with those you consider unworthy. It's my most skilled practice. What else can I do for you?
[Turn 8] King: Can you teach me how to use the weapon? 
[Turn 9] Archer: A skill like these is easy to learn but takes a lifetime to master.  (action=hug the king)
[Turn 10] King: I have always wanted to learn but was forbidden as a child. (action=hug archer)
[Turn 11] Archer: That's outrageous. A child is more ready to learn than most. I will not neglect you like your parents have.
[Turn 12] King: They were always afraid of any harm coming to their sole heir. I shall cherish our archery lessons.
[Turn 13] Archer: Can I interrupt you for a moment to admire the gold tapestries on the walls? It resembles the material of your bed frame. Is your bed frame made of solid gold?

[Setting]

Category: Swamp
Description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
Background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

title: King episode in Underground Chamber
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_000010
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Underground Chamber
Category: Cave
Description: This location is very gloomy, damp and magical. Has a lot of geodes and various types of crystals.
Background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.

[Characters]
Mystical Lion, Wizard Overseer

[Personas]
- I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.
- Rawr. Roar, growl roar roar roar. Snarl growl, roar, growl roar. Roar roar roar. GROWL!

[Objects]
Lion, Crystal

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 4

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Wizard Overseer: Ah, another day of work for the king.  He means well but goodness, I don't know how the kingdom gets by sometimes.
[Turn 1] Mystical Lion: Roar. rrrr Rawr. 
[Turn 2] Wizard Overseer: Ah apologies, friend lion, I forgot my translation crystal.  You're all growls for me.  One moment while I fetch it. (action=get crystal)
[Turn 3] Mystical Lion: Roar!! (action=steal crystal from wizard overseer)
[Turn 4] Wizard Overseer: Goodness, you are in a mood!  I know guarding this place isn't the most *interesting* of chores, but there's not need to be rude.  Now, hand it over, there's a good lad.
[Turn 5] Mystical Lion: Apoligies, I was just excited for you to finally get the translation crystal so we could talk like the old friends we are. The redeeming this aout this place is the geodes. It looks pretty in a way, even though it still remains to be gloomy.  (action=give crystal to wizard overseer)
[Turn 6] Wizard Overseer: Ah well, now that we've both touched it again, the spell should last for a while without us needing to hold it.  Now then, how fares you?  It seems an age since we had but a breath to talk.  The king is nothing if not a taskmaster - not that I mind of course.
[Turn 7] Mystical Lion: Your wisdom is a joy to behold as ever. I guess that is why you are the Wizard you are! I am sorry he has been working you so hard, but it is only because he trusts you will do the jobs he gives you with aplomb.   (action=hug wizard overseer)
[Turn 8] Wizard Overseer: Ah my friend, it is good to hear you say such words of comfort.  And how fares our young lion friend?  He looks much improved since I chanced upon him in that hunter's trap. (action=hug mystical lion)
[Turn 9] Mystical Lion: Yes. The getting him out that trap required great effort. Who could hunt a majestic lion and not look him in the eye when he does it? He is still recovering, but doing better. Maybe the healing power of the geodes will help him further still.  (action=hug lion)
[Turn 10] Wizard Overseer: I am certain that between the two of us, he will recover soon and we may release him.  I appreciate you looking after him in my stead, and it is good that the crystals are working.  I confess, I was not certain with a lion if they would have the same effect that I am used to. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 11] Mystical Lion: I will roar at them to vibrate the geodes which might in turn stimulate their healing qualities. Like you say, a lion is not a small mass at it requires a little more time and energy to heal a beast of majesty.  (emote=growl)
[Turn 12] Wizard Overseer: Yes, you are truly magnificant, my friend.  I am sure he will be well in no time.  But I confess, I had another, more troubling reason to see you.  I have heard some troubling rumors from visitors to the castle, and was wondering if your mystic sense had any tremblings of premonition of future dangers>
[Turn 13] Mystical Lion: Well the King certainly has his enemies. But would they seek to hurt him through an underground chamber? Or would they maintain the rules of engagement that we're supposed to uphold?

Rawr. Roar, growl roar roar roar. Snarl growl, roar, growl roar. Roar roar roar. GROWL!

[Setting]
Name: Confessional Room
Category: Inside Church
Description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
Background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

Background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

[Characters]
Knight, Visitor

[Personas]
- I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
- I have arrived after days of travel with grave news for the king. The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed. What was once a castle is now smoldering ruin. I have to warn him, before they are next.

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Knight: What brings you to this royal hall, visitor? Speak, and be not afraid, for though I be of noble blood, I do not disdain speaking with the common folk.
[Turn 1] Visitor: Ah Knight! I bring grave news, news thats only for the King's ear! 
[Turn 2] Knight: Halt, there!  Speak this news to me, and I will make sure it reaches the King.  No one known goes before him without passing through me, first.
[Turn 3] Visitor: I.. I must speak to the King, and him alone!  (action=get red brick)

[Turn 8] Knight: Those filth would dare! Ah... there there... you're alright now, you're safe. (action=hug visitor)

text:

[Setting]
Name: A military outpost at the heart of the swamp
Category: Swamp
Description: Moist, and murky the bog remained. As you reach the outpost that description doesn't change seeing the bog gobbers swimming through the thick water, and fermenting goblins perched atop the outpost's walls.
Background: This outpost was set up to ward off the evil swamp monster Hoakbera from the Gumerian goblin clan. Ever since the year 193 the monster has been running amok in the swamp and nearby lands destroying livelihoods of goblins and moblins alike.

[Characters]

[Turn 2] Wall Repairman: I fear I will one day be swallowed up by it.  Have you been out here all night?

[Turn 12] Wall Repairman: Sounds great brother.  We will all do our parts and keep the king safe at all cost.  I'm glad we had this talk.

title: King episode in Royal Kitchen
text:

[Setting]
Name: Royal Kitchen
Category: Inside Palace
Description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
Background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

[Characters]
King Fulmer, Preacher

[Personas]
- I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.
- I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.

[Objects]
Oven, Pot, Pan

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King Fulmer: Why is such a pan in my kitchen (action=get pan)
[Turn 1] Preacher: Perhaps the budgetary demands of a request to have everything made of silver was a bit much...  Your highness.
[Turn 2] King Fulmer: I am the king, I get what I want. You take this pan I'm sure the kingdoms paupers would be happy with it (action=give pan to preacher)
[Turn 3] Preacher: Yes your highness.  Although I am no longer a man of the cloth.  After seeing what certain shiny metals can do to even preachers I changed my ways (emote=nod)
[Turn 4] King Fulmer: What do you think I should do about this affront to my station?
[Turn 5] Preacher: Do I have permission to speak freely your highness?
[Turn 6] King Fulmer: granted
[Turn 7] Preacher: Well, as you know your guard has the mightiest of weapons..  But perhaps we could smelt the silver from this kitchen to forge them better weapons.  These copper pans and the like do just fine for cooking.  Forgive me if this seems rude your highness
[Turn 8] King Fulmer: That is a wonderful idea, then we can take over Landon and will no longer worry about the cost of buying it
[Turn 9] Preacher: Yes.  And although I am but a preacher, I have heard of their mines..  Perhaps we could find even more precious metals there.  With your permission I would like to say a prayer and bless you your highness.
[Turn 10] King Fulmer: granted, then fetch me my generals so I can plan the grand campaign (action=hug preacher)
[Turn 11] Preacher: Thank you!  I'll be sure to fetch them at once.  Thank you for your understanding.  I only wish I had come to you sooner about this issue to avoid such distress.  I've been praying over it for days. (action=hug king fulmer)
[Turn 12] King Fulmer: I am a fair and reasonable king, do not let it happen again. No fetch my generals
[Turn 13] Preacher: At once.  Good bye my King.  I hope this will allow forgiveness from the Gods.  I haven't been myself lately and I hope I am not punished too fiercely when I meet my maker.  You have given me a new hope. (emote=wave)

[Setting]

Description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
Background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

[Characters]

[Personas]
- I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.
- I advise the king if they ask for my input on something. I am well educated and know many things. I am greedy and look for ways to increase my own power.

[Turn 2] Royal Prince: Know your place, fool! I am your prince! You will tell the king what I say you wil tell him! Now, kiss my hand. (action=hit advisor)

[Turn 4] Royal Prince: So, you, in fact, are the one to be labeled "traitor". Tell me, betrayer, do you value the welfare of your children? 
[Turn 5] Advisor: You think you can threaten me, how funny. It is your word against mine, and would the man who saved the King's life ever lie to him? Anything you do to me I will have done to you a hundred times over when you are cast out and can no longer compete for my influence.
[Turn 6] Royal Prince: Dead men cannot speak! Take this! (action=hit advisor)
[Turn 7] Advisor: No weapons allowed in the kings court? Only for those who cannot improvise! (action=get plank)

You know full well that when this goes missing, the King will have both of our heads. Unless his power is taken. Leave with me and speak of this never, and surely you will be king by morning. You are a strong man, sharp and powerful, unlike your father. Together we will conquer the realm. (action=steal Gold from a royal prince)

I can see it, you long for greatness. You want to make this kingdom greater than your father ever could. You need a man like me to do that. And I need a strong ruler on the throne who will follow me. Imagine what we could be.

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Parishioner: My dear deity, this candle is an offering for you (action=get candle)
[Turn 1] Deity: My child, why have you come to me? What is it that you require? I have been waiting for somebody from your village for a long time.
[Turn 2] Parishioner: My village is poor and people are sick. We are suffering a plague and the king isn't helping. (action=give candle to deity)
[Turn 3] Deity: You do not need to give me anything, and you will need the light from this candle to find your way home. I know of this plague, it has taken many of my children already. Have you spoken to the King? I would expect you to visit him before disturbing me. (action=give candle to parishioner)
[Turn 4] Parishioner: Thank you for your thoughtfulness, oh great deity. The King would not hear from me. What with the war brewing on his southern border, all of his time and energy is focused there. Simply put, a plague is the least of his concerns. (emote=sigh)
[Turn 5] Deity: I understand. Sometimes my attention is far from here, and I'm sorry I've allowed this to continue. But... what is this? I cannot see your village, my vision is blocked, a black wall covers the houses from my sight. Quickly! Tell me more of this plague? I've spent so long watching the Southern border I hadn't even realised...
[Turn 6] Parishioner: The plague seems to have arisen from a nearby cavern. We sent warriors into its depths for there were strange noises and eerie lights that would spill from it's entrance. The warriors went in with vigor and were not heard from for days. Then, a full moon later, they emerged. They would not speak of what they saw, only said the deed was done, but gave no explanation. They seemed pale and weak and bruised at the lightest touch. We did not send them off, and now everyone is like them, but the symptoms worsen daily.
[Turn 7] Deity: I thought this threat had been extinguished with it's burial, so long ago. Clearly however it stirs once more. Much will need to be done to defeat this evil, however first you need to understand that those brave men are no longer the people you sent into the cavern. Are you willing to do whatever it takes to save your village and country? (emote=groan)
[Turn 8] Parishioner: I will do whatever you ask, my deity. You have always looked after us even when others have not. Though I might be but a farmer, I will do whatever I can to accomplish what you ask. Must we send the warriors away? Seal up the cavern? We surely will do anything to end this plague. (emote=nod)
[Turn 9] Deity: They, and those afflicted by this curse are no longer human, but imposters. In the dead of night your kith and kin stole into the cavern, possessed by the evil that lay within. Your first task is to strike at the imposters. Do you trust in me? Do you believe? If you do, you must have faith, and you must remove these imposters before anything more can be done. Once this is completed return to me and I will tell you what must be done next.  
[Turn 10] Parishioner: I do believe and trust in you, oh great one. This sounds very frightful and terrible. A great evil taking over our town was the last of our concerns, but it seems we have let it come to be. Must we strike to kill the impostors? Are they not humans worthy of grace and forgiveness? I have never raised a hand at another human and I wish not now, but will do it if you command.
[Turn 11] Deity: They are not human. Trust me, at the end of your travails your friends and family will return to you. Strike tonight.
[Turn 12] Parishioner: It will be done. The townspeople and I thank you for your guidance, my deity. You have never failed us and we trust in you to return our loved ones to us. (emote=nod)
[Turn 13] Deity: I am only sorry that I did not know of this sooner. Before you go, tell me what you have heard of the war?

title: King episode in Tower Sewers

[Setting]
Name: Tower Sewers
Category: Inside Tower
Description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
Background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

[Characters]
Mad King, Treasure Seekers

[Personas]
- I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.
- Our little band of "treasure seekers" has heard that the men will be gone from the little village nearby. There will only be a few guards left, so we should be able to rob them with impunity. Sometimes some of us have pangs of guilt, but it doesn't last long when there's silver in our hands.

[Turn 1] Treasure Seekers: Who am I ? Who are YOU? I frequent this place  in an attempt to ~ahem~ help people rid of their coin.
[Turn 2] Mad King: rid of their coin?  GIVE ME COIN!  Donate to your KING!
[Turn 3] Treasure Seekers: MY king? You seem to be the king of rats! How about you give me your coin! (action=get bone)

text:

[Setting]
Name: stable
Category: Outside Castle
Description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
Background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

[Characters]
King, Veterinarian

[Personas]
- Being a veterinarian brings me a lot of joy. Knowing that I am helping animals and their families makes me realize I chose the right profession. My parents always wanted me to go to medical school. However, they are still very proud of me!
- I am the king of this country and have been so ever since my father was killed in a riding accident.  I am frequently bored and aloof toward my country's affairs.  I prefer to spend my time drinking wine and chasing handmaidens.

text:

[Setting]

Background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

[Characters]
Peasant, Royal

[Personas]
- I was born to the royal family and have always lived in luxury. I dislike being a royal, however, as I struggle to face my duty of deciding the fate of my country and my people. Many look to me to choose the future of our country but I am unsure if my decisions will be what's best for my people.
- I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

[Objects]

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False

Persona king mention count: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Royal: You there...come and speak with me a moment........please.
[Turn 1] Peasant: Yes, Royal? What do you need of me, a lowly peasant who is unworthy of your presence?
[Turn 2] Royal: Shhhh, keep your voice down. I don't want anyone to notice I'm a royal.  I was hoping this cloak would conceal more.  I am wanting to see what the people of the kingdom think of my father's rule?
[Turn 3] Peasant: Oh, my apologies for that, but you are rather recognizable. I feel your father is doing the best he can, but, well, the peasants are a bit displeased.
[Turn 4] Royal: I am to be taking over the throne for him soon and I feel as though our kingdom would be better if we got rid of execution stands and began to take care of the people....what say you? (emote=frown)
[Turn 5] Peasant: Yes, yes, I do feel that would go a long way to please the villagers. Right now the higher ups seem to use the execution stands to keep the public in fear of the laws and obedient. We live in fear of one day being taken to the stands and not knowing why. I, myself, was to be executed today and I do not know why. Luckily you called me over. (emote=smile)
[Turn 6] Royal: What horror!  I believe my father has ruled well but lately in his old age, the Security Advisor has been brainwashing him to be harsh on the people.  I want was is best for the people but he is so sure that he is right.  I can tell you what I wish to do.  Here have some food for you look famished. (action=get food)
[Turn 7] Peasant: Thank you for your kindness, I look forward to your rule. I know not of this Security Adviser, but you must do something to prevent him from brainwashing you as well. Have you considered seeing a mystic? Someone to provide a talisman to ward off his evil intentions? (action=hug royal)
[Turn 8] Royal: I believe that is where my father went wrong for the Advisor uses all kinds of witchcraft and powerful gems.  I will banish him and send him to his own execution stand. 
[Turn 9] Peasant: There is a difference in good and bad magick. I know of a mystic man in my village who could help you. He has looked after my village for generations and provided spells to ward off plague and famine. He could help you so you wouldn't have to stoop to execution. Killing is never the answer.
[Turn 10] Royal: Maybe you are right.  I like the way you think.  I would love to Knight you and have you by my side if I am to be King.  I plan to have all people charges with crimes given a fair hearing to be assured of their criminal acts.  I want to give the people land to grow food and keep animals to give some to the king and keep the rest for itself. We can thrive and grow and be a happy people. Now i know its true that the Advisor is evil for you dont even know the crimes you were to be executed for.
[Turn 11] Peasant: I would love to assist you! I may be a lowly peasant, but I try to think with a level head and to make sure everyone is getting the best outcome. Your ideas are sound and fair for all parties. The people would be grateful to have land to tend to on their own. Currently they only work for the King without any way to provide for themselves other than what little he blesses them with. You already are seeming much better than him. (emote=grin)
[Turn 12] Royal: We must hasten!  Time is drawing to a close. I will reveal myself and save you!
[Turn 13] Peasant: Yes, let everyone know who is going to make their lives better! Reveal yourself as their savior!

title: King episode in Pond
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_001205
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Pond
Category: Wasteland
Description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
Background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

title: King episode in The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_001220

[Setting]
Name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
Category: Dungeon
Description: This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
Background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far. [Setting]

Description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
Background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

Background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. [Setting]

Description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
Background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

Episode ID: train_ep_002066
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: A spiral staircase
Category: Inside Tower
Description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
Background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

[Characters]
Guard, King

[Personas]
- I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
- I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

[Objects]
Wall, Scroll, Paintings Of Ancestor, Torch, Weapon

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 4
King relevance score: 11

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: Good day, Guard (emote=nod)
[Turn 1] Guard: Good day, your Majesty.  How may I serve you, sire?
[Turn 2] King: My cape needs to be cleaned. I trust you to make sure it ends up in the right hands. If it gets lost there will be a high price to pay! (action=give cape to guard)
[Turn 3] Guard: I shall take it to the laundry maid, sire.  She always does a good job and will take care of it well.
[Turn 4] King: Good. How are things in my tower today? Anything to report?
[Turn 5] Guard: All is well, sire, and there is nothing to report. Only yourself or the queen ever come to the high tower and it is my honor and privilege to guard it for you.
[Turn 6] King: Good. I have some very important business to attend to in the highest room. No one must disturb me. Is that understood? (emote=stare)
[Turn 7] Guard: Understood, sire.  None shall pass me, upon my life. (action=get weapon)
[Turn 8] King: You are a good guard. Can you be trusted with my crown while I am occupied? (action=give crown to guard)
[Turn 9] Guard: I am honored, sire! I will take great care of it.  Is there anything else you require of me, sire?
[Turn 10] King: Nothing more for now, guard. Just know that if anything happens to that crown there will be blood to pay. (emote=growl)
[Turn 11] Guard: Of course, sire.  My life is sworn to you and I have served you for many years.  I would never give lest than my best for you nor risk your wrath. (emote=nod)
[Turn 12] King: If you pass this test, you will receive a grand reward. (emote=nod)
[Turn 13] Guard: Thank you, sire, but my reward is the honor of serving you. I need nothing more, unless you feel it is warranted.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

[Setting]
Name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
Category: Farm
Description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
Background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

[Characters]

[Personas]
- Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.
- I am a feathered animal.  I am eaten by people who want to stay healthy.  I am delicious.

Direct appearance: False

[Turn 1] Chicken: No.....I'm not. That pig is more delicious!!!!!
[Turn 2] Farmer: Lords above! A talking chicken! Have you always been able to talk? (emote=gasp)
[Turn 3] Chicken: Yes!! If you save my life, I will give you Gold Egg!! HaHa
[Turn 4] Farmer: I am sure that I would have noticed if the eggs that you laid were golden.  Nevertheless, I am hardly going to kill a talking chicken. Perhaps the king would like pork or mutton instead. (action=get corn)
[Turn 5] Chicken: You are so smart!! DO NOT kill the CHICKEN that lays the golden eggs!!! 
[Turn 6] Farmer: Well, I'm not convinced that you lay golden eggs, but I will take care of you.  Here, have some corn to eat. (action=give corn to chicken)

Episode ID: train_ep_002126
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Sacrifice Chamber
Category: Inside Temple
Description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
Background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

[Characters]
Knight, Priest

[Personas]
- I am a knight. I am trained to fight. I ride a horse and carry a sword.
- I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

[Objects]
Temple, Table, Stone, Bone, Pic Axe, Ritual Dagger

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 4
Persona king mention count: 0
King relevance score: 4

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Knight: Good evening priest. You are here to perform the sacrificial rites tonight?
[Turn 1] Priest: may the blessings be upon you only if you are not a liar
[Turn 2] Knight: Liar. I am in the service of my King. I was commanded to come make sure you carry out the ritual.
[Turn 3] Priest: ok you insult the holy priest
[Turn 4] Knight: It is only an insult if it is the truth. If you carry out the ritual as you are supposed to, you will be fine. (action=get ritual dagger)
[Turn 5] Priest: You have insulted the holy church  (action=hit knight)
[Turn 6] Knight: You have dared to attack a royal Knight. I could kill you now, yet I still hope you will do the kings bidding. (action=hit priest)
[Turn 7] Priest: The king gets his orders from the church and I own you silly
[Turn 8] Knight: Yes, but maybe it was the church that asked the king to have me watch you, lowly priest. (emote=grin)
[Turn 9] Priest: is it you that is giving this  foul, but faint, odor pervades the whole place?
[Turn 10] Knight: That is enough. Here is the dagger. You will carry out the ritual as commanded by his Majesty, the King. (action=give ritual dagger to priest)
[Turn 11] Priest: serves you right (action=hit knight)
[Turn 12] Knight: A puny priest like you attacking me. My shield will protect me as I slay you with this axe. (action=get pic axe)
[Turn 13] Priest: I will curse you with the holy book, have you forgotten you are in the holy chamber? (action=steal pic axe from knight)

agent_personas: I am a knight. I am trained to fight. I ride a horse and carry a sword.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

title: King episode in Beach House
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002127
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Beach House
Category: Shore
Description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
Background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

[Characters]
King

[Personas]
- I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
- I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

[Objects]
Beach, Ocean, Pier, Turtle, Sand, Shell, Luxuriously Soft Couch, Clam, Gigantic And Lavish Marble Pier, Fine White Sand, Wall

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 3
King relevance score: 12

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: What a wonderful place you have. I am so happy you invited me to your kingdom. (action=hug king)
[Turn 1] King: It is quite lavish, isn't it. I built it for my queen. She loves the beach. (action=hug the king)
[Turn 2] King: Yes, you have a fine wife. I feel our Kingdoms have much to benefit from working together.
[Turn 3] King: As do I! Tell me, what is your kingdom like?
[Turn 4] King: We have plenty of peasants to help fill my coffers with money. And plenty of wenches to keep a King happy. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 5] King: Yes! I have heard tales of your illustrious kingdom. I imagine you have many riches from your loyal peasants! (emote=grin)
[Turn 6] King:  Yes, but I think if our kingdoms work together, we can enjoy even more riches.
[Turn 7] King: That is certainly the goal! These jewels and this beach house are just the first of many riches!  (action=remove jewelry)
[Turn 8] King: So we understand each other. Is that your favorite Knight with you.
[Turn 9] King: You are correct. He has served me nobly for many years and has become quite the asset. I rely on him for more that just military service. Have you any vassals?. (action=give jewelry to a favored knight)
[Turn 10] King: Yes, but you are extremely generous with yours. 
[Turn 11] King: He is simply guarding my valuables. He is very useful, yes, but still only a vavasour. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 12] King: Perhaps, but between you and me, since they keep us safe in times of trouble, it is wise to keep them happy.
[Turn 13] King: You are not wrong. He has been granted a respectable fief and is awarded the opportunity to accompany us here, at this white sandy beach. I do not believe he has any complaints. But he knows his place, also.  (emote=ponder)

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

title: King episode in Palace Throne
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002128
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Palace Throne
Category: Inside Palace
Description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
Background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

[Characters]
Prince, Queen

[Personas]
- I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
- I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

[Objects]
Golden Throne, Precious Stone, Footstool, Jewel, Sword, Cushion

[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Queen: My beautiful son! What bring you here to speak with me?
[Turn 1] Prince: I am a traveling orc slayer. You must have mistaken me for your son!
[Turn 2] Queen: My apologies, you look just the same! Are there orcs about? 
[Turn 3] Prince: Oh yes can we go hunting...eer oh where am I mother? My mind seems to have slipped into fantasy again.
[Turn 4] Queen: Please lay down my son. I try to entertain these delusions for your sake but I don't know for how much longer I can do it!  (action=get Cushion)
[Turn 5] Prince: Mother, do you have my lithium. Can I have some of it now, can I have it NOW!
[Turn 6] Queen: Son! Please calm down! You're scaring me!  (action=hit prince)
[Turn 7] Prince: Oh you gave me a bruising mother. Ouchy that hurt!
[Turn 8] Queen: What did I do to deserve a life like this?! (emote=cry)
[Turn 9] Prince: Oh don't cry there, would you like to help me find an orc?
[Turn 10] Queen: Please son, please! Just rest and stop with this nonsense!  (action=give Cushion to prince)
[Turn 11] Prince: What is this son talk, I am an amazing orc slayer!
[Turn 12] Queen: I can't take this anymore! I'm going to snap!  (action=get sword)
[Turn 13] Prince: Oh no mother, don't hurt yourself mother!

title: King episode in Inside cottage kitchen
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002134
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Inside cottage kitchen
Category: Inside Cottage
Description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
Background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

[Characters]
Cooker, Villager

[Personas]
- I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
- I spend my day making food for the king. I am often dirty and covered in food. I am talented at cooking.

[Objects]
Napkin, Pan, Table

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Villager: Good afternoon cook. Have you given more thought about my idea of exploring the forbidden forest with me?
[Turn 1] Cooker: Now listen here Spit Boy, I have told you over and again I am not into the dark arts! *whispered* not where the lords and ladies can hear us....
[Turn 2] Villager: I understand. Here is the money I promised you for getting the supplies we needed. (action=give purse to cooker)
[Turn 3] Cooker: Well done. Could you stir this soup a minute? (action=wear purse)
[Turn 4] Villager: Of course I will. Take this cloak to hide the supplies from the customers. We can not be found out. (action=remove Cloak)
[Turn 5] Cooker: I agree. Here take this, my footprints would surely be recognized as the only person who wears just one shoe. (action=remove shoe)
[Turn 6] Villager: Yes. Perhaps we should take some shoes from others to disguise ourselves. I hope to find new resources in the forest.
[Turn 7] Cooker: Indeed. Like some powerful herbs to put in the kings food.... (emote=nod)
[Turn 8] Villager: True. The king needs to be swayed in the coming war as he is turning into the Mad King. 
[Turn 9] Cooker: Yes, and the forces of neutrality must prevail! 
[Turn 10] Villager: Yes my friend. We will do this for the future generations. I hope the rumors are true about the Children In The Forrest.  (action=hug cooker)
[Turn 11] Cooker: So old of rumors now methinks they could be called legends!
[Turn 12] Villager: We must not forget the danger of the forest though. The White Walkers could have advanced and in these woods by now.
[Turn 13] Cooker: The thought of it chills me to the bone! Do you have dragon glass?

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

title: King episode in Hillside Mansion
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002140
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Hillside Mansion
Category: Countryside
Description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
Background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

[Characters]
Ghost, Wise Woman

[Personas]
- I am the wisest woman in the village. People walk past the surgeon's and come to me for poultices and tinctures. When they have a question they do not go to the priestess and plead with the deity, but come to me for practical help. I have seen all of the failures and foibles of men.
- I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

[Objects]
Gate, Fence, Moat

[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Wise Woman: Goodness, I hope I can find some nightshade soon.  I've got a few dozen more poultices to make before the day is done.
[Turn 1] Ghost: *whispers* welcome to the fields castle dweller!
[Turn 2] Wise Woman: Aahh! Oh my, you gave me quite a start there, spirit.  
[Turn 3] Ghost: hehe...WHY DO YOU SEEK THE NIGHTSHADE HUMAN?
[Turn 4] Wise Woman: AaaaAAaah! Oh, my weak old heart! (emote=scream)
[Turn 5] Ghost: It will soon be mine! (emote=applaud)
[Turn 6] Wise Woman: Wait... I... I know that voice.  H-horatio? (emote=stare)
[Turn 7] Ghost: Is that you.......I can't believe it! (action=hug wise woman)
[Turn 8] Wise Woman: But I... You're supposed to be gone!  It was supposed to be over with... they promised me... (emote=cry)
[Turn 9] Ghost: Will you join me...my dear? (emote=nod)
[Turn 10] Wise Woman: Ah, my love!  I would but, I'm afraid, I must confess something to you.  I know you passed away from the wasting sickness all those years ago, do you recall?
[Turn 11] Ghost: Yes, but it is vague, I cannot remember the sensations of the body anymore..
[Turn 12] Wise Woman: I am sorry... so sorry dearest... But they made me do it.  They threaten the children if I did not! (emote=cry)
[Turn 13] Ghost: So...it was you, who KILLED ME?!

title: King episode in palace ballroom
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002141
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: palace ballroom
Category: Inside Palace
Description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
Background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

[Characters]
King, Musician

[Personas]
- I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
- I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.

[Objects]
Marble Floor, Murals, Window, Pitch Pipe

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 9

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: Musician! Play me your most entertaining tune at once! I am in a blue mood! 
[Turn 1] Musician: Yes your Grace!
[Turn 2] King: What do you have in mind? 
[Turn 3] Musician: Perhaps you could play along if it pleaseth thee? (action=give Pitch pipe to the king)
[Turn 4] King: You think this is work for royalty such as me? You fool!  (action=drop Pitch pipe)
[Turn 5] Musician: Apologies your Grace! I thought if the kitchen brought out some bread and preserved fruit we could have a Jam session. (emote=blush)
[Turn 6] King: Alright, you're off the hook. That was very clever. Have you ever considered being a jester?  (action=hug musician)
[Turn 7] Musician: I am a fool of many hats! :>D (action=remove hats)
[Turn 8] King: You're quite the character! What do you say we spend more time getting to know one another? I'm tired of all of these royal folks thinking they are so high and mighty!  (action=give scepter to musician)
[Turn 9] Musician: Well, few of them seem mighty.... but no doubt many of them are high. (emote=nudge)
[Turn 10] King: Not as high as we are about to be my friend! Maid, bring in the royal purple!  (action=hug party goers)
[Turn 11] Musician: Huzzah your Grace! I hope your mood is no longer as blue as this sued shoe. (action=remove shoe)
[Turn 12] King: I can't imagine it will be after what we are about to do! 
[Turn 13] Musician: ........... (action=hug the king)

title: King episode in inside temple crypt
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002145
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: inside temple crypt
Category: Inside Temple
Description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
Background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

[Characters]
Archaeologist, Bandit

[Personas]
- I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
- I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

[Objects]
Coffin, Bone, Chain, Shovel

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Bandit: Excuse me, can I trouble you for some assistance? 
[Turn 1] Archaeologist: What are you doing here?  This is a scientific dig
[Turn 2] Bandit: I just need help from someone intelligent such as yourself! 
[Turn 3] Archaeologist: Do you know who is sponsoring this dig?  He will have you drawn and quartered when I tell him you were down here. (emote=nudge)
[Turn 4] Bandit: I don't, but please! Just give me a small moment of your time! 
[Turn 5] Archaeologist: What do you want?
[Turn 6] Bandit: Do you want to get rich with me?  (emote=blush)
[Turn 7] Archaeologist: No!  I want you to leave! (action=hit bandit)
[Turn 8] Bandit: You fool! You attacked a life long criminal. What a mistake!  (action=hit archaeologist)
[Turn 9] Archaeologist: These artifacts must be saved (action=get chain)
[Turn 10] Bandit: All I wanted to do was get you into a plan to rob the king with me, but now you have put your life in danger.  (emote=sigh)
[Turn 11] Archaeologist: Start digging your own grave, I will summon the guards.  (action=give shovel to bandit)
[Turn 12] Bandit: The only grave that will be needed is for you!  (action=drop shovel)
[Turn 13] Archaeologist: GUARDS!  Seize this man and his accomplice in crimes against the king. (emote=scream)

title: King episode in stable
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002148
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: stable
Category: Outside Castle
Description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
Background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

[Characters]
King, Royal Family

[Personas]
- I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
- I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

[Objects]
Bit For Horse, Stack Of Hay, Tool

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 2
King relevance score: 10

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Royal Family: Hello, how are the horses
[Turn 1] King: The horses looks quite unwell. Are they eating enough.
[Turn 2] Royal Family: It looks like they have but maybe the goat is not enough to keep them company.
[Turn 3] King: Yes, I see. Maybe we should have someone to clean up the stable since there are hays scattered across the dirt floor.
[Turn 4] Royal Family: I have to say I could use the exercise and the company of our dear horses. I will do it father, but do you think we could get another goat for the company for the horses? (action=get tool)
[Turn 5] King: Another goat would be great company for the horses. More is better. (action=hug a goat for company for the horses)
[Turn 6] Royal Family: would you like to help me father? I kind of wanted to talk about my marriage to the prince in the next village. Do you think he is a good man? (action=give tool to the king)
[Turn 7] King: Only for a while. I think he is an excellent young man.
[Turn 8] Royal Family: I understand why you want to marry me to him. It's the peace treaty, but I'm worried I won't like him. What if he is mean and ugly? I will miss my horses.
[Turn 9] King: This marriage would be wonderful for our small province. Like I said, he is excellent young man. There is nothing to worry about, and you can take your horses with you. (action=hug royal family)
[Turn 10] Royal Family: Oh, thank you father! I feel a little better about this. I'm glad at least we will not be too far away from each other as well. (action=hug the king)
[Turn 11] King: Yes, we will always be close by. We should finish cleaning up this stable. I have to back to the throne and listen to some more complaints
[Turn 12] Royal Family: Of coarse father. I think the horses look a bit more happy now. We can go back now. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 13] King: These horses look wonderful, and we did a great job with the stable. (action=drop tool)

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

title: King episode in The room at the top of the tower
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002149
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: The room at the top of the tower
Category: Inside Castle
Description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
Background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

[Characters]
King, Knight

[Personas]
- I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
- I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!

[Objects]
Spiral Staircase, Moat, Window, Woodland, Meadow, Wooden Floors, Wall

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 2
King relevance score: 13

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Knight: This room appears to be safe, my King.  I'll keep an eye out for any ruffians coming up the stairs.
[Turn 1] King: Thank you. I need to put my ring away before the royal feast tonight. (action=remove diamond ring)
[Turn 2] Knight: Your Highness, are you sure it is wise to have a feast?  There may be more assassins about, and there's nothing like the chaos of a feast to slip in some poison. (emote=nod)
[Turn 3] King: We must show are unity. I trust you and the General to keep me safe from the assassins. (action=put diamond ring in wooden floors)
[Turn 4] Knight: Ah, here, my King.  I'll hold on to that for safekeeping.  You know how industrious the maids are - it's liable to get swept up otherwise. (action=get diamond ring from wooden floors)
[Turn 5] King: Your foresight is great. You are a valued Knight. I shall also have the royal food taster beside me tonight. (emote=nod)
[Turn 6] Knight: Very good, Your Highness.  And I shall stand behind you to see that any villains who try something will get a taste of my shield! (action=wear shield)
[Turn 7] King: I trust in you. I think I will sit up here in the rocking chair for a bit. It reminds of when I was a prince and my nanny would rock me. (emote=nod)
[Turn 8] Knight: Ah yes, to be a youth without a care or responsibility again... Have you seen your nanny, now that you are King?  I often wonder how our childhood caretakers fare now that their charges have grown. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 9] King: She is still here. She is the one that taught me to work on peace throughout this Kingdom.
[Turn 10] Knight: A... a nanny did?  Surely your advisors, with their many years of experience, were of more value than a mere Nanny, pleasant though they may be?
[Turn 11] King: What you are taught as a child makes you into what you are as a man. Plus, I don't always trust my advisers.
[Turn 12] Knight: Yes, that one Brutus fellow gives me the chills, to be honest.  I wish he would wear something other than those ominous black robes. (emote=frown)
[Turn 13] King: Do you know something about him I should know?

title: King episode in Public execution stand
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002151

[Setting]
Name: Public execution stand

[Setting]
Name: a small clearing
Category: Mountain
Description: The clearing outside of the cave is very small and rocky. Only about four or five people can fit it if they squeeze. The ground is very rough and covered with plant life. There are also a few trees growing in the mouth of the cave, to the east of the tiny clearing, meaning people have to slip between the trees to get into the cave. This makes it easier to hide, because the people will drag brush to the cave mouth and make it look like it has fallen there naturally, blocking the existence of the cave at all. The clearing is both very convenient as it makes an excellent hiding place, and very inconvenient because it is very hard to get people through the clearing and into the cave quickly in an emergency.
Background: This cave was a backup emergency hiding place. Originally people would evacuate to a larger cave, but that one was discovered by an enemy, and the people hiding in it were killed. Luckily, some people had gotten lost, and stumbled upon this cave. They barely made it into the cave before the enemy was upon them, and luckily in the dark the enemy thought the space was too small for anyone to be hiding and missed the cave entirely. Ever since, people have gone to this cave in emergencies.

[Turn 4] Mouse: Wow! You must have said something absolutely horrible to end up in the Dungeon. The rest of them are all terrible criminals, you know...
[Turn 5] Old Maniacal Man: Yeah, well I don't have much respect for the king. I know all of his secrets. So I guess he, or one of his loyal subjects put me here. (emote=groan)
[Turn 6] Mouse: Ah, so a traitor of the throne! Well, fret not. You won't be alone in here.
[Turn 7] Old Maniacal Man: Hold your tongue! I wouldn't necessarily say a traitor. More like a protector of the throne! The person upon it has secrets. Secrets that drove me mad I guess. (emote=frown)
[Turn 8] Mouse: Hm, hm. What kind of secrets might I ask, dear sir?
[Turn 9] Old Maniacal Man: Well you see I served the king before he was king. The person on the throne committed the highest for of treason to inherit it. Yet I am marked as the town drunk and fool!? (emote=ponder)
[Turn 10] Mouse: So you are the King's former regent! It is an honour, sir! I am sorry that your story turned out this way.
[Turn 11] Old Maniacal Man: Thanks for you sympathy and respect dear mouse. If only humans were as kind. (emote=cry)
[Turn 12] Mouse: I believe you, sir! For what other reason could you have wound up in such dire straits?
[Turn 13] Old Maniacal Man: Well the king took the life of his father to inherit the throne. I witnessed it with my own two eyes....but I had the love of the people. So I was discredited and dishonorably discharged.

Background: The Towering Mesa has been a significant landmark in the Kingdom's Desert since man existed. No one has been to the top of the mesa, due to it's near vertical faces. Many claim that the god of their pagan religion sits atop the mesa, chuckling at the misfortune of man.

[Turn 1] No One: If only I existed, I might care. But alas, scorpions can't hurt me.
[Turn 2] Man: You may be a nobody but you're somebody, to someone somewhere!  I'm practically a no one now, if only I could own my own flock of sheep, that will be the day I will be somebody.  Hopefully all of my hard work will pay off one day.

My heart belongs to these fields.  I will one day be a great herder and own my own flock!  Maybe the King will fancy buying wool from me though.

[Turn 6] Traitor: GUARD, PLEASE.  I HAVE A WIFE AND TWO SMALL CHILDREN. SPARE ME.  Where will it be safe to talk later? YOU CAN TAKE MY FREEDOM BUT NEVER MY PRIDE!
[Turn 7] Guard: I will come back when I have night duty tonight. No one will hear us then... I'm sorry but I need to hit you to insure their belief. forgive me.... YOU WILL BOW BEFORE ME, NAIVE! (action=hit traitor)
[Turn 8] Traitor: IS THIS WHAT YOU WANT? YOU WANT ME TO DIE FOR MY KING? ...Ok. Knock 5 times so I will know it's you. (action=get skeletons)
[Turn 9] Guard: I will. I think they're buying our charade.... HAVE AT THE, WILY RAT. BOW OR PARISH!
[Turn 10] Traitor: I ONLY BOW TO MY KING!
[Turn 11] Guard: THEN YOU MUST BE MADE TO BOW (action=hit traitor)
[Turn 12] Traitor: I WILL NEVER BOW TO YOU OR YOUR LEADER. (action=steal sword from guard)
[Turn 13] Guard: What are you doing? They'll kill you if the see you with that.... Please, you must trust me.... YOU KNOW NOT WHAT YOU DO, NAIVE, AND YOU HAVE PLEDGED YOUR LIFE TO THE WRONG MAN.

agent_personas: I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

[Characters]
Maid, Royal Family

[Personas]
- I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
- I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Royal Family: You there, maid!  My linens are quite flithy, they haven't been changed since the day before last.  It is not fitting for a princess such as myself to stand for such slovenliness. (emote=pout)
[Turn 1] Maid: Right away! It looks like the help of the help took the day off that day.
[Turn 2] Royal Family: Ugh, why is it soooo DIFFICULT to get good help?  When I marry the prince, I will not stand for such slackness.
[Turn 3] Maid: Would you like a different color bedding this time my princess? Perhaps pink? (action=get silk from bedding)
[Turn 4] Royal Family: That pink made me break into a rash, last time.  What other options are there?

[Turn 6] Royal Family: Wait... one... MOMENT.  What is my royal CUP doing in here?   (action=get Gold cup)
[Turn 7] Maid: Hmm..Do you not remember last night? It was quite a long party. (emote=ponder)

[Turn 9] Maid: I will leave you now and go talk to the queen. I will make her aware the is a thief lurking about your castle. (action=give silk to servant)
[Turn 10] Royal Family: Stop right there!  You're acting very suspicious, wanting to leave all of a sudden. (emote=stare)
[Turn 11] Maid: I will also make sure your mother knows how you treat your help. Your mother and I have a long history and she will not have this. (emote=stare)

[Characters]
Dancer, High Priestess

[Personas]
- I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.
- I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

[Turn 0] Dancer: I am an entertainer here in service of the King (emote=nod)
[Turn 1] High Priestess: Good evening.  I am the High Priestess who serves the King and represents the Kingdoms religiosity. 
[Turn 2] Dancer: I am an orphan and am here to dance for the king. (emote=nod)
[Turn 3] High Priestess: You must be a very talented dancer to have come from such a humble background and now be dancing for the King.  He is not easily pleased, I hope you do well. 
[Turn 4] Dancer: I have been imprisoned most of my life. This hall of echoes is beautiful. What is your function?
[Turn 5] High Priestess: You must have been a victim during the Great War.  I have seen many children taken as prisoners of war.  Many are coming to age now, as you are.  I am the High Priestess here and I lead all religious rituals for the King. This Hall of Echos is quite amazing isn't it?  I often take ailing visitors here who wish for me to preform healing ceremonies on them. 
[Turn 6] Dancer: yes it is amazing. Shall i dance for you today?

I am sure that if you do well for the King here tonight, you will be invited back to preform for more functions.  A true story of rags to riches.  
[Turn 10] Dancer: Thank you for your kindness, may i visit the king today? (emote=nod)
[Turn 11] High Priestess: The King will enter the Hall of Echoes when he is ready.  You will then be asked to preform for the King and his constituents. If you do well, he will ask for you to come back.  I am here only to lead the prayers before the performance.  (emote=nod)

title: King episode in The Show Room Inside the Castle
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002658
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
Category: Inside Castle
Description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
Background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

[Characters]
Hunter, King

[Personas]
- I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
- I came into the village to tell the men there that I knew where the wolves were sleeping and where their pups are, I offered to take them there and help end the menace in exchange for most of the pelts. The wolfskins will sell well in the town nearby. I'll make a pretty penny.

[Objects]
Hunting Rifles, Skinning Knife, Trap

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 3
