[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: This place is creepy. I get the feeling I am being watched. 
[Turn 1] Hunter: Your highness, that is not a good thing indeed. I've just come to let you know I have news on the whereabouts of those damned Wolves and their pups. 
[Turn 2] King: What???? wolves and pups.... maybe you should capture the pups to tame for hunting
[Turn 3] Hunter: Oh nay my lord, it is hard work indeed to tame a pack of Wolves. One or two maybe but not a whole pack. I would be sure to see my fate.
[Turn 4] King: Use them for protection around the outside of the kingdom. Keep them on strong chains close to the castle gates.
[Turn 5] Hunter: If those are you orders, I must oblige. You are a wise King indeed. (emote=nod)
[Turn 6] King: Others would think twice before they approached.
[Turn 7] Hunter: Very true indeed my lord. I will gather supplies as soon as I leave. 
[Turn 8] King: Take this for your efforts and if you want sell it for coin. (action=give sceptre to hunter)
[Turn 9] Hunter: Oh my you are very generous my King, I shall bring back the pack of wolves for you. 
[Turn 10] King: Make sure it is just the pups, not the adult wolves
[Turn 11] Hunter: Yes my lord. They will be much easier to tame as pups. Very wise indeed. I shall not disappoint (emote=nod)
[Turn 12] King: Thank you. You are very grateful and good hunter.
[Turn 13] Hunter: May you and the Queen, live a happy and prosperous life my lord. (action=get trap)

title: King episode in bone pit
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_002661
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: bone pit
Category: Outside Temple
Description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
Background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

[Characters]
Ancient King, Angel

[Personas]
- I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.
- I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.

[Objects]
Spike, Cauldron, Remains, Moss

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 4
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 5

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Angel: Why you are a peculiar fella, do you need help?
[Turn 1] Ancient King: I do. I seem to have found myself in this pit. Imagine that, a king like me being thrown down here.
[Turn 2] Angel: A king you say? Why who would throw a king down this pit.  (emote=frown)
[Turn 3] Ancient King: A rival king, that's who. Say, what's an angel doing down here? Are you here by choice?
[Turn 4] Angel: Me? I love helping people, so I like to come down here when those in need require my aid. 
[Turn 5] Ancient King: What kind of aid can you provide? I hope it's better than what this last guy down here was offered.
[Turn 6] Angel: Why I wasn't here to help him! I am here to help you out of this pit you landed yourself in of course.  (emote=grin)
[Turn 7] Ancient King: But at what price? Who wanders around helping the fallen and expecting nothing in return? (emote=ponder)
[Turn 8] Angel: Why no price at all! You need help, and I would love to help. If only this world was filled with more love, it would just make me so happy. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 9] Ancient King: I remain skeptical. I've been on this world long enough to know nobody does anything out of the kindness of their heart. So what's your price? Money? Fame? My soul?
[Turn 10] Angel: Well if you require a price for my help, I'll set it at a single hug. Yes that will do. (emote=smile)
[Turn 11] Ancient King: Again, I remain skeptical, but my choice is either to die or accept your help. Whom do you serve? (action=hug angel)
[Turn 12] Angel: I serve the big man up in the sky of course. I can assure you I mean no ill harm towards you my friend, I am simply an angel who is good at heart.  (action=hug ancient king)
[Turn 13] Ancient King: But why save a man like me? I have certainly done little to please your master in my lifetime. I guess I shall remain in his debt, perhaps that is price. Where will your travels take you next? (emote=sigh)

[Turn 1] King: I have come to admire this temple that was built for me! I also need an anniversary gift for my wife, the queen. Do you have any suggestions? So many choices. (action=wear crown)
[Turn 2] Servant: Have you seen this?  One of our knights recently returned with it from the holy land.  It is a piece of the true cross, thought to bring luck and long life to anyone who possess it. (action=get artifact)

[Turn 0] Villager: Old man, what are you doing in this abandoned castle?
[Turn 1] Elderly Man: Oh, my son! I've been waiting for you to return! It's been so long...you look so different (action=hug villager)
[Turn 2] Villager: I'm sorry, I think you must be confused.  I lost my father long ago at sea, and have been a blacksmith for the king's army since I was a young boy.  What do you know of my father? (action=hug elderly man)
[Turn 3] Elderly Man: Father? Whats this speak of fathers? Who are you? What are you doing in my castle? (emote=ponder)

[Turn 6] Villager: I know of a place that has lots of weapons.  The town apothecary has a cannon, and a doctor, but mostly a cannon!  I fear if we don't use it my wife and children will never see me again.

Background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

[Characters]

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Person: Your majesty, is that you?
[Turn 1] King: Don't be so foolish, of course it is I!    We were to meet here to discuss the temple artifacts that rightfully belong in my castle!
[Turn 2] Person: Well I am not the owner of this temple, so of what good am I to you?
[Turn 3] King: The temple guard is here to help us.  I assumed since you were one of my royal subjects you would assist me in the transfer of these items.  I have heard tell you have means of transporting precious items such as these discreetly . 
[Turn 4] Person: Well, yes I do, but that is quite under wraps so I'm surprised that someone as important as you has heard of that. But yes, I can assist in this.
[Turn 5] King: Very good!  I think it goes without saying that the queen also approves of this move.  We rule together and I would not want anyone saying I acted in haste.  
[Turn 6] Person: Of course, your majesty. So do you know which artifacts we are moving or is that part of the discussion?
[Turn 7] King: Well as you know, my brother the king of the west kingdom has laid claim to these artifacts, but everyone knows that they are rightfully mine.  My father the king before me promised that these would be a part of the castle collection.  So I would like to take all of them.
[Turn 8] Person: Every last one? What would that leave of the temple?
[Turn 9] King: There are still luxurious decorations, and people do not come to the temple to seek artifacts they seek to worship.  You do realize that this task will have grave consequences for you and your family if you fail this mission. 
[Turn 10] Person: Well with that in mind I will surely follow through, but these artifacts are religious just as this temple is, which is why I am concerned for their removal.

It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. Description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. [Setting]

Description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
Background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

Episode ID: train_ep_003394
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: The tower base
Category: Outside Tower
Description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
Background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

[Characters]
General, Guard

[Personas]
- I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
- I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.

[Objects]
Path, Tower, Moss, Torch

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Guard: The stars glow with the strength of the fallen (action=get torch)
[Turn 1] General: So you can see it too?
[Turn 2] Guard: Aye General. Something brews. Be ready,  (action=give sword to general)
[Turn 3] General: Remember what we fight for. (action=give photo of his family to villager)
[Turn 4] Guard: Light the way villager, and be ready.  (action=give torch to villager)
[Turn 5] General: For the sake of the kingdom we must be successful.
[Turn 6] Guard: For King and Country! (emote=scream)
[Turn 7] General: Commence the charge, let none of them survive!
[Turn 8] Guard: If we perish, we shall great the after life with their souls in our hands!
[Turn 9] General: Well spoken, I pray that we all make it home.
[Turn 10] Guard: Indeed. I dream of holding my wife once more
[Turn 11] General: Pray that you do, it is a terrible thing to lose someone you love.
[Turn 12] Guard: The Gods know our quest is just and our hearts are true. I believe we will live to save our king, hold our families, and stand in this moss covered tower once more. (action=get moss)
[Turn 13] General: May the Gods watch over us in our fight.

title: King episode in The King's Quarters
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003397
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: The King's Quarters
Category: Inside Tower
Description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
Background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

[Characters]
His Queen, King

[Personas]
- I'm the current wife of our beloved King. I was sold to him by my family. I didn't like him at first, but I've started finding pleasure in the little things that happen here. I enjoy how everyone looks up to him, and I hope I will soon love him as my husband.
- I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

[Objects]
Gold-Laced Furniture, Clothes, Portraits, Bed, Pillow, Self-Portrait, Rug, Various Diamonds

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 9

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] His Queen: Shall we get a case for all these diamonds? (action=get various diamonds)
[Turn 1] King: Ah!  My Queen!  Call the servants for a case and let us feast! (emote=scream)
[Turn 2] His Queen: Okay, you don't have yell, here hold these diamonds for me, while I call the servants, also, thank's for the suggestion. (action=give various diamonds to the king)
[Turn 3] King: I apologize.  I haven't eaten in hours.  I want soup and wine! (action=hug his queen)
[Turn 4] His Queen: Ah, I know how it feels to be hangry. Let's arrange a feast tonight, shall we?  (action=hug the king)
[Turn 5] King: I would like to talk to you about our child's baptism.  I would like to invite only the most royal and richest in the land.  
[Turn 6] His Queen: Yes, our precious child deserves the best baptism the kingdom's ever witnessed. We shall do it during sunset. (action=hug child)
[Turn 7] King: I want the finest painter in the kingdom.  How can we find him? (action=hug child)
[Turn 8] His Queen: The designer of this very rug, is the same artist whom painted the royal portraits. The painter's name and address is behind those portraits. (action=get rug)
[Turn 9] King: Please arrange for them to be here for the baptism.  What about music?  How can we find the best? (action=give various diamonds to his queen)
[Turn 10] His Queen: We shall contact the musicians whom perform outside of the castle, they produce the best beats. (action=put various diamonds in the bed)
[Turn 11] King: What other details would you like to see?  Perhaps we can have some of our gold-laced furniture out for the guests to relax on?
[Turn 12] His Queen: Excellent idea, I would be pleased to see that. And perhaps we can add additional diamonds to the furniture. (action=get various diamonds from the bed)
[Turn 13] King: Use my jewelry to plan the colors.  I want to match everything, including the servants clothing.  I do not want them to be seen, unless they are beckoned.   (action=remove jewelry)

agent_personas: I'm the current wife of our beloved King. I was sold to him by my family. I didn't like him at first, but I've started finding pleasure in the little things that happen here. I enjoy how everyone looks up to him, and I hope I will soon love him as my husband.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

title: King episode in A spiral staircase
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003398
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: A spiral staircase
Category: Inside Tower
Description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
Background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

[Characters]
King, Servant

[Personas]
- I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
- I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

[Objects]
Wall, Scroll, Weapon, Paintings Of Ancestor, Torch

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 3
King relevance score: 12

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: Ah, my good man.  Are you new? I don't think that I have seen you before.
[Turn 1] Servant: Aye, sire. This is my first season as a servant. I hope I will be able to serve you in... any way you desire.
[Turn 2] King: Jolly good.  I dare say that you will provide a very valuable service to myself and my lady queen.  Are you enjoying it here in the castle? Food good, lodgings adequate, that kind of thing?
[Turn 3] Servant: Quite sir! I used to live in a barn, so the cupboard below the dungeon staircase is roomy! Thank you, sire.
[Turn 4] King: Excellent,  Sorry about this but my wife ... the queen .. keeps telling me that I need to be more 'hands on', more of a 'man of the people' kind of thing.  She tells me it's a new, modern world.  This is the Century of the Fruitbat, she says ... can't just go around lopping people's heads off because you have a bit of a headache.
[Turn 5] Servant: ... Well... if you're asking for my advice about being a man of the people... I would suggest you assemble an army to eradicate the dragon infestation from the farm corner of the kingdom. Many people of the village blame you since, well, um, your lead wizard conjured it and all...
[Turn 6] King: I'm not quite sure that I'm up to taking advice from servants yet but I suppose that you may have a point.  In fact, I am pretty sure that I'm not up to taking advice from servants yet. (emote=frown)
[Turn 7] Servant: Sire... do you not recognize me?
[Turn 8] King: You told me that you just started working here.  How would I recognize you?
[Turn 9] Servant: You don't recall the court you held a fortnight ago? You greeted peasants to hear their qualms? Do you remember that little girl whose family was slaughtered by that dragon? (emote=smile)
[Turn 10] King: Ohhhh .. you're her? You look very different.
[Turn 11] Servant: I had to disguise myself to get a job as your servant... to exact my revenge. You wouldn't listen, dear king, when I told you of the destruction, of the mass graves. You shooed me away. And now, now I will avenge my family! (emote=stare)
[Turn 12] King: I am pretty sure that getting rid of the dragons would be better revenge, don't you?  Now, I may not be up to taking advice from servants but I would certainly take advice from my new Chief Advisor on Peasantry Affairs.  Better for the kingdom all round, don't you think?  Worth thinking about, at least, especially when you consider that I have trained in warfare since the age of 5.  What do you think .. Chief Advisor?
[Turn 13] Servant: If you think promoting me is going to keep me from your brutal slaughter... you may be right...

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

title: King episode in Confessional
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003399
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Confessional
Category: Inside Church
Description: The red velvet curtains provide privacy and speak to the washing away of sins as the repentant person leaves the booth. The solid oaken bench provides no comfort, and hurries the churchgoer along in their confession. Behind the sheer screen is the waiting priest. Ornate designs are carved into the side of the confessional. Above it is a painting, dulled by age, but still depicting Jesus' death and resurrection with resounding clarity.
Background: The confessional is as ancient as Catholicism itself. Since the beginning of the Sacrament of Penance, this tiny, benched room has provided countless sinners with respite from their sin.

[Characters]
Churchgoer, Waiting Priest

[Personas]
- I am a churchgoer. I go to church. I talk to a lot of people and praise god.
- I am a priest. On Saturdays, I wait in the confessional booth so that people can confess their sins, before attending Sunday services the next day.  It is my job to absolve them of their sins, usually after requiring a small penance in the form of prayers or putting a coin or two into the poor box. Even the king trusts me to keep his sins secret and never disclose them.

[Objects]
Painting, Curtain, Sheer Screen, Booth

[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Churchgoer: Hello priest, I am here to confess my sins. I go to church every Sunday, I love God, but I have done wrong.
[Turn 1] Waiting Priest: It is ok my child, I will listen and together we can absolve your sins (action=remove a suit of armor)
[Turn 2] Churchgoer: I have sinned. I stole a pack of gum from the grocery store. I just really needed something to chew so badly.
[Turn 3] Waiting Priest: Did you not have any money to pay for the gum?
[Turn 4] Churchgoer: I did, but I needed it for the strip club.
[Turn 5] Waiting Priest: My child, is stealing the gum the only sin that you need to confess?  It sounds like there may be more.
[Turn 6] Churchgoer: Well, I did accidentally kill a spider the other day.
[Turn 7] Waiting Priest: well accidents do happen, now lets get back to what happened at the store.  You said you had money to make the purchase but chose to not pay is that correct?
[Turn 8] Churchgoer: Yes. I am so sorry. Will God forgive me? 
[Turn 9] Waiting Priest: God will forgive your sins my child but what can you do to make this situation better? How will you make things right with the store?
[Turn 10] Churchgoer: I spent all my money at the club. I am so broke. I could mop their floors for them I suppose.
[Turn 11] Waiting Priest: I think mopping their floors would be a good start.  I also think it would be wise for you to speak with the store owner and apologize for your actions.
[Turn 12] Churchgoer: I will go tomorrow. Thank you so much. Shall we pray now?
[Turn 13] Waiting Priest: Absolutely, today I would like for you to start the prayer if you feel comfortable with it.

agent_personas: I am a churchgoer. I go to church. I talk to a lot of people and praise god.

I am a priest. On Saturdays, I wait in the confessional booth so that people can confess their sins, before attending Sunday services the next day.  It is my job to absolve them of their sins, usually after requiring a small penance in the form of prayers or putting a coin or two into the poor box. Even the king trusts me to keep his sins secret and never disclose them.

title: King episode in Adjacent to the Guest Castle
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003403
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
Category: Farm
Description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
Background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

[Characters]
Farmer, Gypsy

[Personas]
- Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.
- I'm a gypsy woman from a land far away. I spend my life traveling across the kingdoms. I have seen things others dream of/

[Objects]
Sheep, Horse, Tool, Corn

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 7
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 6

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Farmer: Greetings.  How are you on this fine day? (emote=smile)
[Turn 1] Gypsy: Quite well. Quite well. Tell me, farmer, do you happen to grow any foods of certain.. magical properties?
[Turn 2] Farmer: I grow whatever the King wants me to, usually.  I can't say that anything I have growing at the moment is 'magical', per se.  A bit odd, possibly ...
[Turn 3] Gypsy: Anything the king doesn't know about, perchance? For if you do, I have much coin to spare.
[Turn 4] Farmer: Oh, the King knows all about the odd mushrooms.  He likes to use them to play pranks on some of the courtiers.
[Turn 5] Gypsy: Ha! What a naughty king! Well, what a shame, what a shame. Say, what are your thoughts on the king? (emote=smile)
[Turn 6] Farmer: He takes care of me and my family well and, as far as I can tell, he is generally a good king.  A .. special .. sense of humour sometimes, but a good king.
[Turn 7] Gypsy: I see and what are your thoughts on the queen, if I may ask?
[Turn 8] Farmer: I can't say that I've ever really met her.  She is certainly very regal.  Past that, I really couldn't say and, begging your pardon, I wouldn't be at liberty to if I could say.
[Turn 9] Gypsy: Listen... between us, do you happen to grow anything that could be use as... poison?
[Turn 10] Farmer: Why on earth would I grow poison? Deathcap mushrooms, Bloodboil Lilies and Completely Lethal Pinecones all grow wild in the Poisonous Forest.  Let's not even get into the multitude of venemous spiders, snakes, scorpions and hamsters that live there! No one in these parts needs to *grow* poison!
[Turn 11] Gypsy: I cannot grow or catch such wild specimens. No, it must be grown by the hands of an innocent- I mean a farmer. Must be grown by a farmer.
[Turn 12] Farmer: Good luck finding one, then.  More money to be made from antidotes around here.  Believe me, we excel at growing antidotes! Our physickers can diagnose what kind of poison or venom someone is suffering from at a glance and cure it in minutes! That's what comes of living next to the Poisonous Forest!
[Turn 13] Gypsy: Say, could you perhaps point me in the direction of an idle child? Perhaps one that likes to dig up deathcap mushrooms or... catch venomous hamsters?

agent_personas: Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.
I'm a gypsy woman from a land far away. I spend my life traveling across the kingdoms. I have seen things others dream of/

title: King episode in Inside the King's Castle
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003404

[Setting]
Name: Inside the King's Castle
Category: Inside Tower
Description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
Background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

[Characters]
Guard, King

[Personas]
- I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
- I spend most of my day guarding various parts of the castle and surrounding land. I also assist the lord or lady in various manual labor when needed. I live in a barracks with a few dozen other guards.

[Objects]
Highly Fortified Tower, Ornate Goblet

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 10

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: Guard, I beseech thee, come take this crown!
[Turn 1] Guard: Yes your majesty
[Turn 2] King: You are my most trusted guard. It is a privilege to have you in my castle. (action=give crown to guard)
[Turn 3] Guard: It is my honor your majesty. You are not just my king but a dear friend.
[Turn 4] King: I can only hope we will be friends for life. (action=hug guard)
[Turn 5] Guard: So what will you be doing today your majesty? Will you be riding today? (action=hug king)
[Turn 6] King: I believe so, my lord.
[Turn 7] Guard: I will have the royal guard ready.
[Turn 8] King: Let us share a glass of wine before we leave. (action=get ornate goblet)
[Turn 9] Guard: That you m'lord. I do enjoy your fine wine.  I will have a groom prepare your horse for the ride.
[Turn 10] King: Thank you, my liege.
[Turn 11] Guard: Will you be needing a bow and arrow?
[Turn 12] King: I believe so, I am hoping to join the hunt.
[Turn 13] Guard: The priest will be wanting to give you a blessing your majesty.

title: King episode in Across the King's Garden
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003405
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Across the King's Garden
Category: Trail
Description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
Background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

[Characters]
King, Officer

[Personas]
- I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.
- I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

[Objects]
Sun, Shrub, Rainbow, Tree

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 10

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Officer: Your Majesty...are you injured?
[Turn 1] King: No, I am fine, Why are you here?
[Turn 2] Officer: We just apprehended a band of soldiers that came to kill you. They are being taken to the dungeon now.
[Turn 3] King: Really? Let us execute them in the courtyard.
[Turn 4] Officer: Let me guide you to the castle to safety.  There might be more of them around and you are unarmed.  (action=remove sword)
[Turn 5] King: Very well. Tell me do you know the purpose of this attack?
[Turn 6] Officer: I believe one of the enemies were to steal your scepter and bring it back to their king as a test...but they could be lying.
[Turn 7] King: They are nothing more then fools.
[Turn 8] Officer: Please, keep this while we make our way across the gardens.  I'm sorry to take you away from such a beautiful view.  (action=give shield to king)
[Turn 9] King: It is fine you are only doing your job. Are we aware of their numbers?
[Turn 10] Officer: We captured 22 men.  I have the first ranks scattering to find any remaining.  Is there anything else you wish me to do?
[Turn 11] King: You have done enough for today. I need to head to the dungeon and get some answers.
[Turn 12] Officer: Yes Sire.  I will bring report once we are done searching out here.
[Turn 13] King: Thank you for your hard work.

text:

[Setting]
Name: Within the King's Mansion
Category: Inside Temple
Description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
Background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

[Characters]
Butler, King

[Personas]
- I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
- I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

[Objects]
Red Carpet, Torch, Scent

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 3
King relevance score: 12

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Butler: My lord, what beverage may I serve you this evening? (emote=sigh)
[Turn 1] King: I and my lady will be having wine this evening
[Turn 2] Butler: Very good, sir. I will have the servants fetch the wine. How has your day been today?
[Turn 3] King: Wonderful my friend.  I went hunting as you know and I took down a stag.  We will eat hardy!
[Turn 4] Butler: I am happy for you, my lord! (emote=grin)
[Turn 5] King: Speak with the cook...we will have a feast for the entire household.  It is time to celebrate.
[Turn 6] Butler: My lord, I will see to it that we have the greatest feast this mansion has ever seen.
[Turn 7] King: My lady is to give me a son...well...or a daughter.  I could not be a happier man.  
[Turn 8] Butler: Ah, my congratulations to the both of you then!
[Turn 9] King: It would only be a happier day if my father were here...but then again...I would not yet be king. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 10] Butler: Ah, your sense of humor never ceases to amuse, my lord. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 11] King: I will be needing my celebration robes ready for the announcement. (emote=grin)
[Turn 12] Butler: I understand, sir. (emote=nod)
[Turn 13] King: I think I am tired and ready for bed. (action=give cape to butler)

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

title: King episode in Entrance to castle
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003412
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Entrance to castle
Category: Outside Castle
Description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
Background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

[Characters]
King, Knight

[Personas]
- I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
- I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

[Objects]
Moss, Tapestry, Plant, Fairy Lights, Stone

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 2
King relevance score: 12

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: What are you doing just standing there?
[Turn 1] Knight: Apologies, your Royal Highness.  I hoped to forstal you before you entered the castle.  There has been... an incident.  Ah, how well do you trust that servant of yours there, m'Lord?
[Turn 2] King: I trust him well enough to have given a job here. Tell me what this is about knight.
[Turn 3] Knight: I'm afraid it's the Queen, sire.  I overheard her talking to someone, I apologise, I could not make out whom, sire, but they seemed on... intimate terms.  It seems she has designs to unseat you from the throne this very day, either by guile or by... poison. (emote=frown)
[Turn 4] King: Very well let us take action immediately, Thank you for informing me. 
[Turn 5] Knight: Here, your Highness.  You gave this to me in honor of the Battle of Faerie Fire.  I return it to you, that you may defend yourself.  I am yours to command. (action=give sword to king)
[Turn 6] King: Let us find the man she was speaking to. Any idea who it may be>
[Turn 7] Knight: He had on... let me think... a blue doublet.  And his hair was of flaxen golden in color.  He had a rather shrill laugh. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 8] King: Jeffry! It must be him he has wanted the thrown ever since I was coronated, my own brother!
[Turn 9] Knight: What!  Such deep seated treachery is not to be born!  Say the word, sir, and I shall cut him down where he stands! (emote=gasp)
[Turn 10] King: Leave that filth to me. It shall be my sword that strikes that fool down! (emote=grin)

[Turn 4] King'S Architect: Do you know that you just stole a rifle from a member of the king's army? You shall surely be punished! (action=hit king's architect)
[Turn 5] King'S Architect: Ill take my chances, I built the kings castle. I think I am in a better postion than a soldier he has never met?
[Turn 6] King'S Architect: You may have built his castle, but me and my comrades built his empire. Even if I myself die, my comrades will be here standing under this marble arch to bring upon your destruction.
[Turn 7] Unknown: Better put your money where you mouth is then! (action=hit many)
[Turn 8] Unknown: I will attack you with one of the very idols you have built for this church. How does that make you feel? (action=get idol)
[Turn 9] Unknown: Give that back to me, you do not have the power to weild it! (action=steal idol from many)
[Turn 10] Unknown: Ha! While you were distracted I was able to get back my rifle. You are surely finished now. (action=steal hunting rifles from king's architect)
[Turn 11] Unknown: You will not be able to damage me with this on! (action=wear idol)
[Turn 12] Unknown: You are a man alone. I am among many. Your idol only makes you a better target for us.
[Turn 13] Unknown: Attack me and prepare for the afterlife!

I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.

title: King episode in Castle Armory
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003943
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Castle Armory
Category: Inside Castle
Description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
Background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

[Characters]
Army, Knight

[Personas]
- We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.
- I am a knight. I am trained to fight. I ride a horse and carry a sword.

[Objects]
Daggers, Weapon, Axe, Sword

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 0
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Army: Sir Knight are you joining us on our next campaign?
[Turn 1] Knight: Indeed, I am. I live to serve my King! (emote=applaud)
[Turn 2] Army: This is one of the best in the armory. You might weigh it against yours to see which fits you the best. (action=get sword)
[Turn 3] Knight: Let me have a look. Quite a hefty blade this is. I'd say it is the equal of my sword.  (action=steal sword from army)
[Turn 4] Army: I prefer a good ax.  I will be taking this one into battle.  I also have a sword and daggers. (action=get Axe)
[Turn 5] Knight: This weapon looks particularly powerful as well. Never seen a curved blade like this.  (action=get weapon)
[Turn 6] Army: Yes..that one could do much damage sir knight.  Have you heard we are to accompany the queen and her maids to the southern castle? (emote=nod)
[Turn 7] Knight: That much I have been told. Should we expect any interference?  (emote=ponder)
[Turn 8] Army: I fear so sir knight...the prince from across the boarder has looked upon our queen and wants her as his own. The King is outraged and decreed that she is to be protected at all cost. (action=get Daggers)
[Turn 9] Knight: That is a threat we must take seriously! I will make sure no harm comes to the queen at any cost. (action=wear shield)
[Turn 10] Army: Your knights will ride ahead of us and we will flank the queen and her maids.  They will be in a disguised carriage instead of her ornate one.  We don't want to bring more attention than necessary.
[Turn 11] Knight: That sounds like a brilliant plan. Will the queen also be in disguise?  (emote=ponder)
[Turn 12] Army: Yes...she and her maids.  They will look like a noble family which is target enough but at least they will not have the kings shield emblazoned on their carriage. You will also be in disguise...your shields as you can see will only have a family crest and not the kings crest.  All precautions are being made here in the armory.
[Turn 13] Knight: I see the king has gone to tremendous lengths to ensure a flawless journey. I am glad to be in the presence of such dedicated soldiers. I pray that we need not resort to violence though.  (emote=applaud)

title: King episode in inside temple crypt
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003948
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: inside temple crypt
Category: Inside Temple
Description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
Background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

[Characters]
Archaeologist, Bandit

[Personas]
- I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
- I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

[Objects]
Coffin, Chain, Bone, Shovel

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Bandit: Hello sir, I'm lost here. Can you help me find my way out? (emote=smile)
[Turn 1] Archaeologist: Bandit, I think you are not lost! There is nothing here to rob, everything has already been taken. What else could you want? (action=drop shovel)
[Turn 2] Bandit: Ha! You may have seen through my lie, but I'm not afraid to use this shovel if you don't help me get my treasure. (action=get shovel)
[Turn 3] Archaeologist: There is no treasure! If you would like you could dig up any remaining bones. The nobles are paying me to put together the pieces and find anyone that is of importance. I would pay you for your help.
[Turn 4] Bandit: Take me to your king then! I can't wait to rob him. I'm sure he will have more treasure than these empty coffins and rats have to offer. (action=hit archaeologist)
[Turn 5] Archaeologist: The kings guards would take you and put you in prison. You would be outnumbered! Think man! You will not get any treasure from the king. (action=hit bandit)
[Turn 6] Bandit: I am thinking! With this witches broom I shall cast a spell on him so that he forgets I have even robbed him. Do you want to help? (action=steal a witches broom from archaeologist)
[Turn 7] Archaeologist: You are not thinking. You cannot cast spells from a witches' broom. you do not have the power to make it fly. You must have lost your mind bandit! (action=steal a witches broom from bandit)
[Turn 8] Bandit: Well you must know the witch who can cast the spell for us then since you carry her broom. Am I right?
[Turn 9] Archaeologist: No, I do not know of any witch. I found it here in the crypt. It is useless. The witch might have been one that is buried here. You can dig up her bones.
[Turn 10] Bandit: Well, you can't blame a bandit for trying can you? (emote=shrug)
[Turn 11] Archaeologist: I do not blame you, but I will ask again for your assistance to dig up the bones and we will be generously compensated!
[Turn 12] Bandit: I suppose I shall take up your offer, seeing as how it smells so bad in here I might as well do whatever it takes to get out of here as fast as possible.
[Turn 13] Archaeologist: Good! Then we will be able to make double the money. If you find big bones that will be even more money!

text:

[Setting]
Name: Small Hut
Category: Jungle
Description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
Background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

[Characters]
Jacob, Monkey Friend

[Personas]
- I'm the best archer in the village. I can hit a rat at twenty paces. The headman chse me specifically to go on the wolf hunt, saying I was going to be invaluable. I'm a little afraid that the others will run away if the wolves attack us.
- I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.

[Objects]
Table, Primitive Fishing Pole, Brown Cloth Door, Bedding, Wooden Chair, Small Wooden Bowl, Spoon

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 8
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 6

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Jacob: Monkey, tell me, should i go on a wolf hunt? 
[Turn 1] Monkey Friend: I would advise against it Jacob.  The moon will be full tonight and the wolves are very fierce upon a full moon.  I would like us to have a quiet night here with food and ale.  The King wants to see me tomorrow to ask me a question and I worry the queen will be there too.
[Turn 2] Jacob: What makes you so afraid of this meeting Monkey. Allow me to make us some food while you tell your story.  (action=get spoon)
[Turn 3] Monkey Friend: Thank you Jacob. I'll have mine in this bowl.  I'm afraid I've lost respect for our queen.  I saw her with my own to eyes just two nights past with a Nobleman...she was blushing and laughing.  (action=get small wooden bowl)
[Turn 4] Jacob: Ah this is a problem. Perhaps both of us can avoid our problems by running off together. I can provide us food as I am an excellent archer. 
[Turn 5] Monkey Friend: I want to protect our king at all cost.  I stole the pocket watch of the Nobleman and the crest upon it is of a house that despises the king and wishes to take the crown.  The queen is a silly woman and plays with fire.
[Turn 6] Jacob: What makes you so loyal to this king? He has done nothing for me and only wants to use me for my talents. But my talent could lead to my death if the wolves decide to attack. 
[Turn 7] Monkey Friend: I believe Jacob that if we both go to the palace tomorrow that our fortunes will change and your talents will be seen by the King and we will live in great harmony within the castle walls instead of this small and very ugly hut.
[Turn 8] Jacob: My greatest desire is to get out of this hut. But my particular talents are only good for war and hunting. Both will force me outside of this castle and I am not prepared to leave. 
[Turn 9] Monkey Friend: Let us eat our food and drink our ale tonight and you can sleep on it Jacob.  For me I will be talking with our King tomorrow and let destiny take it's course. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 10] Jacob: Destiny is so fickle Monkey. I am worried that you will not be lucky as you wish. 
[Turn 11] Monkey Friend: Mmmm...this food is delicious Jacob...you do have a talent with broth.  You haven't used the talent you spoke about earlier lately...what is it again?  You know my talents are talking, spying and pick-pocketing noblemen. 
[Turn 12] Jacob: My talent is with a bow. I can hit a rat from 20 paces away. I learned from the best archer in the world, my father. 
[Turn 13] Monkey Friend: Was your father in the King's service?  I believe the king could use a man with your talents.  Our king is generous with his coin and you could leave this very small hut.

title: King episode in stable
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_003951

[Setting]
Name: stable
Category: Outside Castle
Description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
Background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

[Characters]
King, King'S Horses

[Personas]
- I am the horse of a king.  I stay at his wait.  The king saddles me and rides me around the village.
- I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

[Objects]
Bit For Horse, Stack Of Hay, Tool

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King'S Horses: Good day to you Master.  I see you have brought the veterinarian.  That makes me happy as I am not feeling well.
[Turn 1] King: How are you talking to me? Am I going mad?
[Turn 2] King'S Horses: Wait, you heard me say that?!  By the gods, what is happening here?!  I have tried to speak to you for years but you have never understood what I have said.
[Turn 3] King: I cannot belive it. The vet will tend to your woes. Tell me do you enjoy being the kings horse? (action=hug king's horses)
[Turn 4] King'S Horses: Oh very much!  We have had good times riding around the kingdom, but my favorite is when we have gone to war.  I enjoy wearing the armor and protecting you in battle. (emote=dance)
[Turn 5] King: Thats good I am glad youre enjoyed being the kings horse. But Im sorry to tell you the vet is here to put you down. (emote=dance)
[Turn 6] King'S Horses: What? Why?!
[Turn 7] King: You have served my valiantly, But I am in need of a younger, fast upgrade. (action=hug king's horses)
[Turn 8] King'S Horses: Fool! One of us will be put down today but it shall not be me. (action=hit the king)
[Turn 9] King: I know it is difficult but it is for the best (action=get tool)
[Turn 10] King'S Horses: You know not what is best.  Instead of killing me you could give me away, or let me live out my days in the pasture.  Instead you are making rash decisions. (action=steal tool from the king)
[Turn 11] King: This isnt  rash desision I have thought about it alot. Prehaps i could sell a talking horse for alot of gold!
[Turn 12] King'S Horses: You've shown your true colors.  You will be lucky to make it out of this stable alive! (action=hit the king)
[Turn 13] King: So will you!

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Chef: You there!  Don't let that soup burn - I want only the finest for the King's honored guests.  And you, who are you to be standing in my kitchen!  Speak up, there, I don't have a moment to spare! (emote=stare)
[Turn 1] Guest: Oh! I'm just- a visiting guest, sorry! I'll get right on it, chef. It smells wonderful in here. (emote=smile)
[Turn 2] Chef: Ah, honored guest of the King!  You must be the one everyone is talking about.  Pardon my rudeness - I have to be sharp with these louts or else nothing would get done!  You understand how it is. (emote=smile)
[Turn 3] Guest: I- well, yes, but I don't mind helping out. I fancy cooking, it's one of those things that I don't get to do myself. I can't wait for the feast, so I traveled down early. What are you preparing? (action=get wine)
[Turn 4] Chef: Hrmp, well.  No offense, good sir, but have you any experience.  I can't risk the king's ire by ruining the meal.  The last chef who displeased him had his hands cut off... and then his head, for good measure.
[Turn 5] Guest: Oh, not really, I suppose I should leave you to it. You won't mind if I watch you cook, will you? I will stay out of the way. (action=drink wine)
[Turn 6] Chef: Well... here don't look so crestfallen.  Hold this at least - be careful, it's quite hot.   (action=give pan to guest)
[Turn 7] Guest: Oh! Alright, I will do that. Anything I can do to assist without being in the way is a joy. When I was a child, I visited kitchens quite a bit! The smells always drew me in. (emote=gasp)
[Turn 8] Chef: So, why is it that the King is bringing in a man such as yourself?  He's usually a reclusive sort, not much for company.  Truthfully this is the most food I've cooked since I started this job! (emote=nod)
[Turn 9] Guest: He calls me in sometimes when he is feeling most lonely. I would like to say he simply likes my company, but I also bring stories from my travels that entertain him. (emote=smile)

[Turn 11] Guest: Yes I had heard about that, nasty business. I will do my best. I brought my book of prayers and my hymn book just in case. They've always been a feeling of- protection for me. How are you dealing with it? (emote=frown)

[Turn 13] Guest: Goodness me, staying out of his way seems like a good idea in that case. I will do my best to cheer him up and give you an easier time. I've stories from the spice markets that I think he will enjoy. Busy place that is! (action=remove scarves)

[Setting]

Category: Graveyard
Description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
Background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

[Characters]

[Personas]

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Leader: Hello, garderner. This shed is in terrible condition.  (emote=nod)
[Turn 1] Gardener: Aye, a right cleanin' and fixin' is what it needs, no ifs or buts about it.  What would you like me to tackle first dear leader?
[Turn 2] Leader: We need to get rid of this moss first. I want to fix this shed, it's a waste to let it die. My soldiers can use this a resting station when we march out in the next spring.  (action=remove crown)
[Turn 3] Gardener: *Begins working on cleaning the Moss*  Oh how lucky you is sir!  Why I was tellin' Alice just the other day - love of me life she is - that any service in the name of the King is service worth doing.  I should so love to find meself in the King's service sir . . . ah, but me commitments at home do prevent it.
[Turn 4] Leader: It does not appear strange that you do not spend much time here. Given the quality of this place, I'm surprised you are even here right now. (action=drop scepter)
[Turn 5] Gardener: Well Sir, me Tomatoes is almost ripe, and I do loves me some tomato Harvestin' - why just the other day Alic was sayin' to me, why those tomatoes are nearly ripe, yes she did, and I said yes they are, not two sundays left till harvest time.  *finishes with the moss*  The folks in the village have been saying there have been some mighty queer goings on in the graveyard these days, might be why the shed was neglected sir? 
[Turn 6] Leader: The graveyard, you say? Perhaps the wild animals that once called this shed their home has found a new caretaker. Speaking of which... Your caretaker, Alice. Where is she now? 
[Turn 7] Gardener: Oh, me Alice!  Love of me life she is!  She be fishmongerin' in Chesterwick village on Mondays, Presterwick on Tuesdays, and Easterwick on Wednesdays.  Why did I ever tell you sir, about how fish sauce can be used with tomatoes?  Why utterly divine sir!  Though me Alice says it stinks enough to scare the devil . . . why I just happen to have some with me lunch here sir!  Should I use some on the shed to keep the animals away-like?
[Turn 8] Leader: My dear friend, how funny you are! You do seem to be in great spirits despite the troubles of war I hear whispering throughout the village. I believe my scouts will be going throughout the city to help my people.  (action=drop shield)
[Turn 9] Gardener: Why Sir!  Your shield must have slipped from yer arm it did!  Musn't let the sigil of the king get all mussed with moss now!  *wipes vigorously with spit and great zeal* Much better now sir!  I can sees me teeth in the shine, or at least those of 'em that are still left.  Who be the King fightin' with these days?  I bet you'll be given' thems a good drubbin' won't you sir? (action=get shield)
[Turn 10] Leader: Those terrible YellowCoats have begun to pillage the nearby towns. Not quite far from here, my scouts returned with a spy. Of course, I am letting you know for I fear some of they may be prominent figures in your village now. That shield serves me a reminder that I protect the people. It does me a great honor that you care for it so deeply.  (action=hug gardener)
[Turn 11] Gardener: Why thank you Sir!  I promise, me an' Alice will be on the lookout for these Yellowcoat dastards, on me honour Sir.  My service has been pledge to you an' the King, and I would not be caught dead dealing with likes o' them.  Why, if it pleases you sir, I shall spit on everything yellow on me way home tonight. (action=hug leader)
[Turn 12] Leader: Haha! How about I give you the honor of wearing this crown after we finish? Perhaps we shall find the spies in your village! You are a trusted friend to the village advisors. You shall employ trickery! They'll be flabbergasted at the sight of a gardener wearing this crown.  (action=give crown to gardener)
[Turn 13] Gardener: Why SIR!  You do me the greatest of honours Sir!  Wait till me Alice hears about this!  Wearin' our blessed leader's crown? ME? Why I be at a loss o (emote=gasp)

[Setting]
Name: attic

Description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
Background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

Background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

[Characters]

text:

[Setting]
Name: inside temple crypt
Category: Inside Temple
Description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
Background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

[Characters]
Archaeologist, Bandit

[Personas]
- I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
- I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

[Objects]
Coffin, Chain, Bone, Torch

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 1

[Turn 0] Bandit: The King has so much gold!  He won't miss it if I take just a little from his ancestors. (action=get torch)
[Turn 1] Archaeologist: Foul bandit! Don't touch that gold! Or else I shall bury you in this crypt and make you history. (action=hit bandit)
[Turn 2] Bandit: Attack me and I shall destroy the remains of Saint Cornelius the Lesser which I hold in my hand! (action=get bone)
[Turn 3] Archaeologist: No not the remains of Saint Cornelius the Lesser! I have spent my entire career digging up bones just to have the chance to find him! (emote=gasp)
[Turn 4] Bandit: Then let me take the gold the King's ancestors stole from the people, and I shall leave you to the bones of your saint! (action=put bone in coffin)
[Turn 5] Archaeologist: Look, I have an obligation to protect the King's gold. But maybe we can strike a deal? How about this ceremonial hat? It is much more valuable that this gold. (action=remove ceremonial hat)
[Turn 6] Bandit: Hmmmm . . . how about I only take enough gold to fill the hat?  The King will never miss it, and I will be quickly on my way. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 7] Archaeologist: Ha! You were distracted pondering such a tempting offer! Now you are without light and the rats here shall make quick work of you. (action=steal torch from bandit)
[Turn 8] Bandit: Aha, but now I have Saint Cornelius the Lesser's Hat! (action=steal ceremonial hat from archaeologist)
[Turn 9] Archaeologist: You may have the hat at this moment, but I'll just come back in a few weeks and pluck it off your corpse. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 10] Bandit: Well, I am taking his bones with me then - I will feed them to the pigs! (action=get bone from coffin)

[Turn 12] Bandit: But since you are the one who grabbed the chain . . . my God!  Your transformation is grotesque! (emote=frown)

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Guard: The Duke of Chesterwick is the most vile fiend in all the land!
[Turn 1] Inhabitant: A humble slave such as myself has no right to an opinion in the matter. But tell me, why is this Duke so vile?
[Turn 2] Guard: He has kidnapped our Queen!  And I would do anything to see her returned - I love her more than life itself.
[Turn 3] Inhabitant: Is that not the King's job to love the queen? 
[Turn 4] Guard: Ah, but the Queen has no husband!  If I were to rescue her - do you think she would look kindly upon one such as I?
[Turn 5] Inhabitant: She may very well do so; however, you would need a company of troops to defeat such a foe as a Duke. Do you have such a compliment at hand?
[Turn 6] Guard: Surely many recruits could be found amongst the people for one as beloved as she?  I know it is not likely she would return my affections, but surely we are better to be governed by a queen than the aimless council which directs the realm in her absence?
[Turn 7] Inhabitant: Then allow me to be your first recruit! I would fight alongside you in exchange for my freedom (action=steal knife from guard)
[Turn 8] Guard: Truly?  You shall be my second in command!  We shall gather a mighty host and march upon the vile Duke's castle! (action=hit inhabitant)
[Turn 9] Inhabitant: Outstanding. Though we must first marshall our troops. Have you any idea how we plan for such an invasion?
[Turn 10] Guard: My apologies for earlier, I meant to embrace you as a brother but was a bit too forceful!   The castle straddle a stream, which if blocked will deprive the Keep of water, giving them only days to surrender. (action=hug inhabitant)
[Turn 11] Inhabitant: But that may risk the queen's life as she too will be deprived of water. And do we have the resources to blockade their gates and defend our dam simultaneously?
[Turn 12] Guard: That is the beauty of the plan!  If they open the gate to send forces to break the dam - that is when we strike!  And surely, if the Queen is the only think with which the Duke has to bargain, he would not let any harm befoul her?
[Turn 13] Inhabitant: A wonderful plan indeed then. Diversion, deception, and a dose of risk. We shall summon the rest of the guard and crush the duke.

[Turn 2] Dragon: Clearly, some of these weapons have been stolen. This room was fully stocked yesterday and now it's practically empty. Do you know anything about this? (action=get weapon)
[Turn 3] Dog: The artillery was fully stocked when the other guard dogs and I did our rounds last night. I find it suspicious that no one has been in here besides you two. (action=steal weapon from dragon)

[Turn 5] Dog: There have been rumours that someone has been selling weapons to our rivals in the town over. Where were you on the night that our stock was taken?
[Turn 6] Dragon: I remember clearly. The children of the town used me to roast their sausages for the feast. I spent the entire evening there, moving from sausages to marshmallows. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 7] Dog: I'm sure you won't mind me checking your alibi with the other villagers at the feast. Did you notice anyone at the feast acting suspiciously? (emote=frown)

[Turn 10] Dragon: I wasn't watching him closely, but I did noticed that later in the evening he seemed larger, as if his close was stuffed with something. Do you think he was the fiend?

Background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

[Characters]
Peasant, Queen

[Personas]
- I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Peasant: Hello, Your Highness. What brings you here to the cemetery? Are you here visiting your father's grave?
[Turn 1] Queen: I am! It is so lonely these days without him. I miss him terribly. I hope this does not show weakness...
[Turn 2] Peasant: It's normal to feel pain after the loss of someone so special. I do think it's sad he's buried in such a dark, dank cemetery, but I know you wanted to keep him close to you. (action=hug queen)
[Turn 3] Queen: It is so somber here and gloomy. I hate it. I wish I could talk to him one last time for assurance... (emote=cry)
[Turn 4] Peasant: I see a ghost lurking over there in the shadows that looks suspiciously like him. Do you think he's here checking up on you? (emote=nudge)
[Turn 5] Queen: Oh yes! This here is my father. Why can I not speak with him? Why can you only speak with him?  (action=hug ghost)
[Turn 6] Peasant: Your Majesty, I spend much time in this cemetery because I have a bond with the dead. I can see them even beyond the grave, and sometimes even converse with them. If, perhaps, there is something you want to tell him, I can pass it on.
[Turn 7] Queen: Do you have special powers? I do not wish to conduct any black magic things...
[Turn 8] Peasant: No special powers. Just a deeply intuitive skill. Apparently because I am so hungry and close to death from starvation, I can branch the divide between life and death. (emote=frown)
[Turn 9] Queen: That is no good! If you tell my father that I love and miss him and wish he did not have to die the way he did then I will provide you food. Also, ask of the rumored news of beheading of my husband. Will it happen? Will I be left alone without a husband, child, and father too?
[Turn 10] Peasant: I have shared your sentiments with him. He said that your husband will be sentenced to beheading but that a rare event will occur just as he is about to be beheaded. He said the sun will be overpowered and will turn black, and that will change the hearts of those who intend to do him harm. He said you and your family will be safe.
[Turn 11] Queen: Oh, I cannot thank you enough! You have just saved my life, and I cannot thank you enough. I would like to invite you a seat at our table for you are worthy of such. (action=hug peasant)
[Turn 12] Peasant: Thank you so much, Your Majesty! My stomach is growling at the thought of it. Now please, I must go and clean up before I visit the palace.  (action=hug queen)
[Turn 13] Queen: Be there in three hours. That should be plenty? I will warn my servants to set a special place for you with welcoming gifts. I cannot thank you enough!

text:

[Setting]

Description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
Background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

[Characters]
King, Powerful But Aged Wizard

[Personas]
- I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.
- I am the official wizard to the king. I give him advice on how to run the kingdom. I enjoy and love using magic in my everyday life. I'm getting old now but I still have a zest for life. I really enjoy doing magic for the local peasants in the village.

[Objects]
Vanity, Fur Carpet, Fluffy Pillows, Curtain, Chamber Pot, Giant Four Poster Bed, Mahogany Writing Desk

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: Well then, wizard, I've glad you've come at last.  We've much to talk about, you and I.
[Turn 1] Powerful But Aged Wizard: Of course Your Majesty, how may I serve you?
[Turn 2] King: It has come to my attention that I've squeezed as much taxes as I can out of the commoners.  However, the third wing of my palace still has a *great* deal of rennovation, and the Hall of Mirrors so I can admire myself is still *quite* unfinished.  I was hoping to consult you as to a way out of my... financial difficulties.
[Turn 3] Powerful But Aged Wizard: Financial concerns are tricky business for a wizard. As you know the alchemy of turning objects to gold is dangerous. Wizards in other realms have long attempted the feat, only to destroy the very castle they wished to improve. Perhaps I can induce the peasants to produce more.
[Turn 4] King: Hrm, I was hoping for a quick fix to all this, but I suppose if you think it wise, I will trust you in this matter.  What do you have in mind? (emote=ponder)
[Turn 5] Powerful But Aged Wizard: Hmm, let's see here. This book may have the spells I need.... Increase focus... Crop growth... Work harder...  (emote=ponder)
[Turn 6] King: Well focus sounds bad - the peasants could decide they could band together and overthrow me.  Perhaps a combination of crop growth and working harder?  And something to attract merchants besides my most magnificent self? (emote=smile)
[Turn 7] Powerful But Aged Wizard: bah, this is no good, this book doesn't have the right spells.  I'll have to rely on my old wizard memory to get through this!  Crop growth should be easy enough, but for the hard work and merchant issue, we'll need to gather the peasants together. (action=put book in chamber pot)
[Turn 8] King: Oh, erm, I *don't* believe the maid has *quite* gotten around to emptying that yet. (emote=blush)
[Turn 9] Powerful But Aged Wizard: doesn't matter, the maid can toss the book out with the royal excrement. now, about gathering the peasants for my spell... (emote=laugh)
[Turn 10] King: Ah yes, well, that shan't be too much trouble.  They're like talking sheep, the peasants.  Fairly easy to herd into one place!   (emote=laugh)
[Turn 11] Powerful But Aged Wizard: I rather enjoy performing for the peasants. They do love a good magic trick. I shall request the town cryer to gather them for a show.
[Turn 12] King: Ah yes, they won't suspect a thing!  Well.. they might be a wee bit suspicious, as I've never allowed it before.  Perhaps I'll claim to have come down with case of generosity! (emote=grin)

text:

[Setting]

Background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

[Characters]
Chiefs, Cook

[Personas]
- I am the chief of the kings' guard. I have many duties to run around and attend to day and night which makes me always on edge and a bit irritable. I am very serious and professional, and I don't tolerate nonsense.
- I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.

[Objects]
Gun, Horse, Dirt, Barrack, Armory, Tree, Log, Bonfire, Dining Hall, Anvil, Wooden Wall, Horseshoe, Sword, Uniform

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 6
Persona king mention count: 0

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Chiefs: Hello, Cook.  (action=get uniform)
[Turn 1] Cook: I have the most incredible sense of deja-vu... like I wanted to be a baker in a previous life.. but ended up as a cook. How bizarre.... Oh hello there! How goes it? (emote=nod)
[Turn 2] Chiefs: A baker? How splendid! What I wouldn't give for a good apple pie right now. I'm doing well. How are you?
[Turn 3] Cook: Well... what would you give for an apple pie right now? HAHAHA! Sorry, bad joke. We've been out of apples for months. Hey I'm hanging on... I wish this bloody war would stop, feels like new faces everyday, I don't even bother keeping up with names anymore.. ah never mind the rantings of an old cook. How can I help ya? (action=put spoon in anvil)
[Turn 4] Chiefs: The king wanted to me to hand out these new uniforms. This was has been going on for over a decade now. Have you heard any rumors about when it might end? Surely the king won't let this go on.  (action=give uniform to cooks)
[Turn 5] Cook: Ah new uniforms. That will do us some bloody good. If food fails us we can always eat the uniform eh? The king the king, tell you what, if it wasn't treason I'd give you a piece of mind about the king. But I've learned to keep my mouth shut, especially after what happened to the Logans. (action=wear uniform)
[Turn 6] Chiefs: The Logans? I thought they moved. What happened? (emote=gasp)
[Turn 7] Cook: Yeah. They moved alright. To the catacombs! Listen, I don't want to talk about it too much but if you even hint of a talk about the King or any of the bloody Royals, you'll go missing. Let's put it this way. each time people go missing we have new meat.. How?? We have been under siege for months now! Nothing comes in nothing goes out. That's all I am saying about that. (action=remove apron)
[Turn 8] Chiefs: I will surely mind what I say. I'm afraid to ask, but...what's for dinner tonight? (emote=gasp)
[Turn 9] Cook: Well, you'll be glad to know it ain't meat! HAHAHA! Wait, I mean you'll be glad to know that right.. unless you're one of those... you know, types who doesn't mind it... What's your name again? (action=get spoon from anvil)
[Turn 10] Chiefs: I'm Bill. I am the chief of the king's guard. May I have a taste? (action=steal spoon from cooks)
[Turn 11] Cook: You fool! That's the meal for the Queen! Do you want to be executed?!! (action=steal spoon from chiefs)
[Turn 12] Chiefs: Well, that's no fun. A chief guard has to eat sometime. All we do is work, work, work.  (action=get sword)
[Turn 13] Cook: Oh don't you worry, Mister Bill. I have this nice lettuce pie for the guards. It's almost out of the oven. Hey also I've seen some young maiden riding a horse around the outpost. They might be spies! You never know about spies. They're clever! That's actually a clever disguise! (action=put apron in uniform)

[Characters]
Shoe Shiner, Soldier

- I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
- The rich often visit me to shine their shoes and make sure they look their best. I dislike dealing with them because they are pompous and look down on me. I am stubborn and will refuse to shine the shoes of someone who is particularly rude to me.
