[Turn 9] Guard: Haha the rush of being nowhere near the battle? Its all about feeling the life seep away from your enemies. Your heart racing because at any time, you may be given a warriors death in the name of the King! (emote=laugh)
[Turn 10] Archer: Do not mock me Guard! I can take you out in the silence of dusk. At least I am not swinging a sword carelessly in battle! I know my targets. (action=hit guard)
[Turn 11] Guard: Dont try to attack at this close range.. You dont stand a chance. Take your stand far away as you normally would. sit back while the real mean take battle (action=get sword)
[Turn 12] Archer: Look at me! I'm a careless swordsman swinging away my sword! Watch out I might slice my own arm off! Say Guard, how many battles have you fought? One? Maybe two? Ha! (action=steal sword from guard)
[Turn 13] Guard: Look at me, a little archer. I miss most of the time and Im never in any real danger. Once someone confronts me head on, im more than likely dead (emote=dance)

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

[Setting]

Category: Wasteland
Description: A run down wooden house buried in sand and dirt. The door is still on the house but the roof is collapsed on itself. Roots and vines cover most parts of the house.
Background: A old testament to man that once occupied the wasteland. How someone used to live in this house was a awe to many citizens of the kingdom.

[Characters]
Queen, Rat

[Personas]
- I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
- I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

[Objects]

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 4

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Queen: I need the provisions of the castle now ...
[Turn 1] Rat: What is a queen doing in this ruin of a house? It's so dirty I didn't think a queen would be there.  
[Turn 2] Queen: For one of my subjects has called me to see this deplorable place, and I wanted to see it personally. I'm worried about winter, I order the supplies ready.
[Turn 3] Rat: Supplies? hmmmm. Do you think you'll restock the kitchen pantry? This wooden house will need a lot of work. I'm surprised the door is still on.
[Turn 4] Queen: Yes, you want to restore those conditions, there is no problem, the castle needs it and the king demands it promptly.
[Turn 5] Rat: I'm hungry, excuse me while I eat some crumbs. It would be nice to have the roof fixed. That would give me more dark places but please leave a few vines. That  would be nice. (action=hug the queen)
[Turn 6] Queen: I insist the king demands the provisions for the castle, otherwise he must take action!
[Turn 7] Rat: I am just a rat. I do not know what that means. I just love to eat and run around the castle. 
[Turn 8] Queen:  Well, as a rat you can eat from the provisions of the castle, besides the winter is very hard and is very close ...
[Turn 9] Rat: I'll really do that. I visit this wooden house all the time. I love that it's buried in sand. It's not as clean as the kitchen pantry in the castle. That's where I eat and sleep. (action=hit the queen)
[Turn 10] Queen: Well, in the castle whenever there is food for this winter everyone will be welcome, even the rats ...
[Turn 11] Rat: What about this house? Why are you going to fix it? Is that why you are hear? (action=get Root)
[Turn 12] Queen: I do not think that we stay in the house is not suitable for a queen and a king, we will go to the castle, there will be plenty of food for the winter.
[Turn 13] Rat: You are not making any sense. When you first came into this house you said you was sent here and wanted to see it yourself.  (action=eat Root)

title: King episode in Inside the temple
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004566
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Inside the temple
Category: Inside Temple
Description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
Background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

[Characters]
King, Person

[Personas]
- I am the blessed and favored.  I can do as I please, when I please.  I bask in his glory.
- I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

[Objects]
Things, Artifact

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 3
King relevance score: 12

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Person: Hello, Your Majesty! Did you come here looking for your daughter? She has been helping me in the temple. (emote=nod)
[Turn 1] King: Yes, I was wondering where my child was. Who are you and what is your work here?
[Turn 2] Person: I'm just a townsperson here at the temple helping to clean the artifacts. The princess has been helping me. She's very talented. (action=get artifact)
[Turn 3] King: That's good to hear, so tell me how is everything in town?
[Turn 4] Person: King, if I may be frank, people seem a little disgruntled. They complain there is not enough food.
[Turn 5] King: How is that so? The rains and the harvest were bountiful why is there no food?
[Turn 6] Person: Yes, the harvest was bountiful, but Sire, you required a 50 percent tax on all crops. It did not leave enough food for this citizens of this village.
[Turn 7] King: Yes, I concur that the tax is high but we needed to fortify our walls, make waterways and pave roads
[Turn 8] Person: Yes, Sire, but also you purchased all these artifacts from the Orient. They truly are gorgeous, but I know they cost a fortune in gold. (action=give artifact to king)
[Turn 9] King: Yes, they are beautiful but these are bought from my personal treasure.
[Turn 10] Person: I see, Your Highness. I did not wish to suggest you were immoral. But how can we provide more food for the people?
[Turn 11] King: We should look at increasing our harvest so that we can feed more mouths
[Turn 12] Person: Indeed, Sire! I was just telling the Princess I thought that could solve all of our problems! (action=hug king's child)
[Turn 13] King: I understand your concerns, in the meanwhile sell this to feed the people in your town. (action=give artifact to person)

agent_personas: I am the blessed and favored.  I can do as I please, when I please.  I bask in his glory.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

title: King episode in Kings bedroom
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004568
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Kings bedroom
Category: Inside Castle
Description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
Background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

[Characters]
King, Queen

[Personas]
- I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
- I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

[Objects]
Wooden Headboard, Large Wardrobe, Door, Large Tapestry, Map Of The Kingdom, Large Bed, Gold, Jewel, Fancy Roof, Sword

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 2
King relevance score: 11

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Queen: hello my noble king, you look gorgeous in your kingly clothing and i hope that you feel the same about me
[Turn 1] King: You do look amazing, my love. It's been a long day and I'm ready for bed. But I'd love to snuggle and hear about your day. (action=remove a suit of armor)
[Turn 2] Queen: i love feeling your kingly body cuddled up against mine. my day has been not so good, but now that i am here with you i am in a heavenly bliss.  (action=hug the king)
[Turn 3] King: Please, my dear, tell me what happened to upset you. Was it the fact that your dinner was not vegan? I know how much you detest meat.
[Turn 4] Queen: that was one of the issues, but i am mostly upset that our foolish son in law is attempting to kill our beautiful daughter.
[Turn 5] King: I sent over several extra guards to protect her, but I know he is a wily sort of person. (emote=frown)
[Turn 6] Queen: i am getting tired. i better hop in the shower and get ready for bed. (action=remove gown)
[Turn 7] King: Oh, I understand. Your duties surely exhaust you. But we must protect the Princess. 
[Turn 8] Queen: That is true. Grab your sword and come with me to attack our son in law.  (action=get sword)
[Turn 9] King: Yes, grand, My Lady! It's time to do away with that villain once and for all!
[Turn 10] Queen: Here, you take this. You are stronger than me. Make a plan to eliminate the evil man and I will gather some guards to help. (action=give sword to the king)
[Turn 11] King: Yes, we'll certainly need help. I have heard here has their home boobytrapped. I don't want anyone to lose their lives - except for him!
[Turn 12] Queen: I've just gotten word that he has killed one of our grandchildren. He knows we are coming and he is killing his family one at a time until he gets to the Princess. We need to act fast and be extremely careful.
[Turn 13] King: Good heavens, no! Here, wear this suit of armor. I want to make sure that you are protected first and foremost. (action=give a suit of armor to the queen)

Category: Countryside
Description: Green large trees surround the meadow that if filled with beautiful seasonal flowers. A deer is grazing in the far end of the field. A small dirt country road gentle crooks past on the outside of the road.
Background: This is gods country. No man could have anything this beautiful. The local government knew it and had this area set away as a protected area years ago.

[Characters]
Deer, Horse

[Personas]
- I am a horse that belong to a knight.  I go with my Master to fight wars but in the times of peace I participate in tournaments.  I have to carry my Master wearing heavy armor but I am strong.  My Master takes good care of me.
- I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

[Objects]
Tree, Small Dirt Country Road, Waterfall, Flower

[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Horse: Hi deer! Beautiful day, isn't it?
[Turn 1] Deer: Hey how are y.. wait! Shhh! Can you ear that? Was that a dog?..... Ok nevermind. Hey how are you doing? It's not a bad day. You're like a deer but like taller right? Like not that deer over there. Just like a taller deer tha.. wait. Is that a dog sound?
[Turn 2] Horse: relax deer... I am a horse.. People rides on me for war or some tournaments. Are you afraid of dogs? (emote=laugh)
[Turn 3] Deer: Am I afrai.. OF COURSE I'M BLOODY AFRAID OF DOGS, MATE! They just hunted Gary the other day. Gary! Gary was the most bad ass deer of us all. He once fought like.. 10 deers at once and won. And the dogs they just ripped him apart like he was a wet paper bag! And then that human with shinny stuff in his head is all like "blah blah" and that was the end of Gary. So yeah! Dogs are not cool bro! (action=get Flower)
[Turn 4] Horse: I have seen worst thing than dogs, deer... human... human are more crazy.. They eat us! They even eat themselves! Well poor gary! may he rest in peace! Are you going to eat that flower?
[Turn 5] Deer: Look buddy. Nothing against you, you just don’t get it. For example, earlier there this crazy lady and her horse, right? They just came in here to that tree and stole all the apples! Now, I don’t particularly care for apples but what if I did? I’d be starving by now. You just don’t have the same relation with humans as we do. They are bad! All of them! Ok most of them. Most of them! Ok some of them. Some of them are really b.. ok a few of them. Look it’s just not easy to be a deer, ok? They love horses! Well ok respect hor.. ok put up .. ok use you up! Alright all I'm saying is, humans.. they suck bro. No actually I'm using the flower as a hat.
[Turn 6] Horse: Easy bro... why don't you hang out with me at the stables? my master is not that bad. He takes care of me. Once we had some pigs but they were gone after new year's eve! (emote=grin)
[Turn 7] Deer: You master only loves you cause he likes to ride you. I've seen your kind helping the humans hunt down my kind! I just can't trust you, man. I can't! Here the flower looks silly on my head. (action=give Flower to a horse.)
[Turn 8] Horse: hmmm... crunchy... not bad... Well... he can ride on you too.. what are you doing alone in the meadow? (action=eat Flower)
[Turn 9] Deer: Ride on me? That will be the day!! I will not serve the human tyranny! Down with the humans!!!! (emote=scream)
[Turn 10] Horse: Ok.. OK... I get it... But why you are here alone? Shouldn't you be with your herd?  (emote=gasp)
[Turn 11] Deer: Ok I feel better now. I needed that. Oh, I like to be alone because no one loves me. JK! I am totes loved. Humans prefer to hunt down packs of us so I thought if I was by myself I’d have better chances. (emote=shrug)
[Turn 12] Horse: Well, just be careful because it is hunting season and human are everywhere. Are you sure you don't want to come with me? (emote=nudge)
[Turn 13] Deer: How can I trust the one that bonds with my enemy?..... JK! Alright where are we going? (emote=wink)

- I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
- I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

[Turn 2] Queen: If that is the case, you shall eat here and rest. Tell me what has been going on out there?
[Turn 3] Royal Dog: Well, (chomp chomp), the Princess was agitated that I left a puddle in her room and had the nerve to call me a bad dog. Then, (nibble nibble), the cook refused to give me a slab of raw beef. Really, it's been a dreadful day so far. (emote=frown)

[Personas]
- I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. [Turn 1] Maintenance Person: I'm well. The king sent me over to see if you have any repairs needed over here. What a beautiful alter! 
[Turn 2] Preacher: It is. It takes my breathe away gazing upon it. There are no repairs needed. Are you a religious man?
[Turn 3] Maintenance Person: What good news to hear no repairs are needed. The king has me working night and day on the castle. It has fallen into a state of disrepair since the war. I am not a religious man, but love the beauty of this church.

[Setting]
Name: Primary Cave
Category: Cave
Description: Dark and with a lot of space in it. The primary cave has a scary look that scares people away. Underneath, in the floor, many precious minerals that no one dares to get out.
Background: The primary cave is respected and feared among people across the land. Tales of adventurers that have gone inside the cave but never seen again are part of the stories told by the elder.

[Characters]
Pastry Chef

[Personas]
- I am an other. I have good taste and excellent style. I am one of a group of people who are related to the king.
- I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.

[Objects]


[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 2
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Pastry Chef: Ah! You startled me! I did not expect to see another person down here in this dark and foreboding cave. (emote=scream)
[Turn 1] Pastry Chef: Sorry about that! Was just taking a break from baking. What brings you down here?
[Turn 2] Pastry Chef: Baking? What on earth could you be baking down here? (emote=ponder)
[Turn 3] Pastry Chef: No, I am not baking down here. I am just taking a break from it. I am a pastry chef and make things for the royal court. (emote=laugh)
[Turn 4] Pastry Chef: Oh my apologies. See I've been stuck in this cave for hours so I assumed you must have been trapped too. (emote=blush)
[Turn 5] Pastry Chef: No worries. If you do not mind me asking, how did you get stuck down here?
[Turn 6] Pastry Chef: I dropped my favorite robe into a hole while talking to the king's cousin. Since I am a man of extraordinary fashion, I couldn't just let it go to waste. So my search led me here.
[Turn 7] Unknown: Oh, I see. So you know the king's cousin, do you? I am sure I have seen this person before as I cook for all of their banquets.

Description: The peak of the Mesa is surprisingly flat, at it's center there's a ring of circles made by rocks sitting in the center of the rocks is a deity statue. A statue of the people's God. In it's hand sits a bowl that is filled with water. In it's other hand is another bowl but this one of fruit and bread. Overlooking the sides are stone ledges and a small alcove to the right.

And that if you did, their God would be waiting for you, laughing at having people waste their time trying to climb such a steep mountain top. But in reality there is no laughing, but their God is indeed there. In the form of a statue, one bowl in either hand. One containing water to quench your thirst for having climbed so high. In the other a simple bowl of fruit and some bread to reward you for your work. No one's sure how exactly someone is getting food up this high but to those that have made it to the top, they secretly believe it's a gift from their God himself. Lastly there are some ledges, and to the right of the statue a warm alcove to rest and watch the day go by from the most beautiful view in the world.

Split: train

[Setting]
Name: The Troll's Lair
Category: Cave
Description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
Background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

[Characters]
Captured Knight, Knight

[Personas]
- I was captured in the most recent battle.  I am lucky to still be alive.  I have to escape soon.
- We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.

[Objects]
Rotting Meat, Stalagmite, Giant Firepit, Bone, Giant Club

[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Captured Knight: My friend, we need to devise a plan to get out of this retched place.  What condition are in?
[Turn 1] Knight: I don't want to be eaten by the Troll! Oh, we are doomed my friend!  (emote=cry)
[Turn 2] Captured Knight: You are a knight of the realm, there is no quit.  We must get out of here before he gets hungry.  Can you lift that giant club?  I have a plan to distract the Troll so we can make for the cave opening but you will need to defend yourself if my plan fails.
[Turn 3] Knight: You are right. Are you certain this club will be of help? What shall I do with it? We must wait till the Troll returns to bed before we act.  (action=get giant club)
[Turn 4] Captured Knight: I'm afraid that will be to late.  I found this turtle here.  I'm going to send him towards the Troll to distract it.  Trolls are not the smartest in the bunch.  My hope is that he will try to eat the turtle and choke on the shell.
[Turn 5] Knight: That is a genius idea! I reckon we able to get away with some his treasured spoils by the wall. Imagine how rich we can get! (emote=grin)
[Turn 6] Captured Knight: I would be happy to escape with my life.  I will not take the chance of angering the Troll more than he will be when he notices we've escaped.  That is an ill-fated plan.
[Turn 7] Knight: Oh nonsense! This mace will only slow me down as I run with the treasure! I will share none of it with you.  (action=remove mace)
[Turn 8] Captured Knight: Thats fine.  If you think you have the time to stop for treasure, be my guest.  Why don't you just swipe the meal off his plate too, while your at it.
[Turn 9] Knight: Would you like some of this? Distract the Troll whilst I make for the treasure. Then we will run to exit.  (action=get rotting meat)

title: King episode in Throne Room
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004753
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Throne Room
Category: Inside Tower
Description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
Background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

[Characters]
Ambassador, Craftsman

[Personas]
- I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.
- I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

[Objects]
Painting, Red Carpet, Crown, Sword, Throne

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Ambassador: I say, this is most irregular to keep such an illustrious personage as myself waiting.  This treaty is not valid until sighted, you know!  (emote=pout)
[Turn 1] Craftsman: I am just a lowly craftsmen waiting for approval to build a large boat
[Turn 2] Ambassador: Does the king here *often* keep people waiting this long? I know he is -technically- king, but there are other kingdoms, empires even, that are much larger and more important than this backwater. (emote=frown)
[Turn 3] Craftsman: I am not aware of the kings usual wait time. I will wait as long as need be as i value my life as well as my livelihood. (emote=wink)
[Turn 4] Ambassador: Well, you seem like a master of your craft.  Surely even *you* know that if a piece does not fit in as it should, it should be cast aside and another chosen.  Not to..erm... suggest treason of course.  Far from it! (emote=laugh)
[Turn 5] Craftsman: Agreed. What sort of treaty are you waiting to have signed? (emote=nod)
[Turn 6] Ambassador: Ah, well, my Queen, who sent me here, was hoping to forge an alliance.  Possibly if things went well, even a marriage, but at this rate... (emote=shrug)
[Turn 7] Craftsman: Are you or your queen in need of a master craftsman? I am an excellent ship builder. I could build the finest vessel for you. (emote=nudge)
[Turn 8] Ambassador: Hm... we could do with some new ships for trading, certainly.  And, I assure you, you would be better treated and, dare I say, better paid than you are now.
[Turn 9] Craftsman: What shall we do with the economist over there with his prying ears? (emote=smile)
[Turn 10] Ambassador: Oh, that one.  He's been in my pocket for years - one does have to keep abreast of politics even when one isn't around.  We've no need to worry about him.  Right, Reginald? (emote=wave)
[Turn 11] Craftsman: That is good to know. What does one have to do to get some bribe money around here?
[Turn 12] Ambassador: Usually just by as we are doing now - little favors here and there, and they add up.  One needn't even always resort to coin for a good bribe.  
[Turn 13] Craftsman: Well i would be willing to build ships for you and your queen for both coin and favors. just let me know how many what size and what purpose they need to serve.

title: King episode in The Winter Gardens
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004757
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: The Winter Gardens
Category: Outside Tower
Description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
Background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

[Characters]
Princess, Worms

[Personas]
- I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
- I am a worm who slides through the dirt. I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest. I can tell some to you, if you would like.

[Objects]
Flower

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 4

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Princess: Ah what a beautiful flower this is! If only this worm would get off of it. (action=get Flower)
[Turn 1] Worms: Please don't hurt me!  I helped grow that flower for you! (emote=scream)
[Turn 2] Princess: Oh I won't hurt you, I don't really have time for that as I am third or fourth in command.
[Turn 3] Worms: Yes, I know who you are, Your Highness, for I have been in this dirt since you were little.  
[Turn 4] Princess: For your troubles! (action=give Flower to worms)
[Turn 5] Worms: That is very kind of you but I climbed up on this flower to tell you something.  I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest and this one is most unsettling.
[Turn 6] Princess: Oh no. Is this about me? 
[Turn 7] Worms: No, but someone close to you. There are bandits that live in the eastern part of the forest and they are plotting evil things.  One of them works in the castle and they are planning to kill the king in two nights.
[Turn 8] Princess: Do you know how they are planning to do it?
[Turn 9] Worms: I know the King would not listen to a worm and I understand that so you must have a guard or servant follow Lord Mortimer around.  He has been going out to the bandits and plotting with them.  His room must be searched for a paper that has a note written that he will deliver to the bandits when its time.  You must find that paper!
[Turn 10] Princess: Yes we must at once! I am not ready to step up to my duties yet. I am just a young girl. Oh my... I must go find my father.
[Turn 11] Worms: Yes, please go and I will be here if you need me. I will let you know anything new I find out.  
[Turn 12] Princess: Do all of the insects of the garden know? I want to make sure before we say goodbye
[Turn 13] Worms: Not all of them can keep that information in their heads to remember but yes...the other worms and caterpillars and the beetles hear everything.  I had an idea to have the king check all correspondence and notes before they leave the castle and as they come...just don't let anything one.

title: King episode in Servant's Quarters
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004759
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Servant's Quarters
Category: Inside Palace
Description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
Background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

[Characters]
Court Jester, Servant

[Personas]
- I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
- I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

[Objects]
Book, Plate, Table, Candle, Silverware, Shelf, Cookpot, Meat

[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Servant: Anything I can do for you sir?
[Turn 1] Court Jester: Oh, please, call me Harold, my good man.  And don't mind me - one of the young Princes seems to find it a little.. too amusing when I fall and hurt myself, so I'm just hiding in here until it's his naptime. (emote=sigh)
[Turn 2] Servant: Sorry... I was cleaning the room a little bit. Hope I did not bother you (action=put rag in shelf)
[Turn 3] Court Jester: Oh, well, truthfully I thought all the servants would be out of their own quarters at this time.  For some reason it never occurred to me that even this room would need cleaning, but I suppose it must, mustn't it? (emote=smile)
[Turn 4] Servant: yeah... it is my turn to do it. If only I can be more useful... (emote=sigh)
[Turn 5] Court Jester: There, there, just think about all the muck you save the rest of us from walking about in.  Why, half the trips and tumbles I do would be on account of the mess instead of my acrobatics! (emote=grin)
[Turn 6] Servant: You make me feel better! Thank you sir... Care for some meat? (action=get meat)
[Turn 7] Court Jester: Don't mind if I do!  Unless... they do feed you enough, here, don't they?  I've never thought to ask... (emote=ponder)
[Turn 8] Servant: I have plenty to eat. My only wish is to meet my family again. It's been quite some time since I last met them (action=give meat to court jester)
[Turn 9] Court Jester: Hm it seems a little.. underdone for my taste.  Perhaps a moment longer in the cookpot... How long is it since you last saw them?  Do they live very far? (action=put meat in cookpot)
[Turn 10] Servant: Not really. They live outside of the town. But as a servant, I am not allowed to get out of the castle. My life is here
[Turn 11] Court Jester: Oh, well.  If you can keep a secret, I do know of a secret tunnel that goes out of the castle.  Sometimes the life of a jester can be a bit.. taxing, so it can be refreshing to walk among normal folk again.
[Turn 12] Servant: Really?? O sir... it will be really nice if you can show me the way! I will be truly grateful! (emote=gasp)
[Turn 13] Court Jester: But of course, tis no trouble at all!  It is nice to make someone smile genuinely, instead of merely the butt of a joke. (emote=smile)

Background: The Hall was built when the previous King, who wanted to leave his mark for all eternity, commissioned his best artists and metalsmiths to work on this statue. [Setting]

Category: Farm
Description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
Background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

[Characters]
Family Member, Farmer

[Personas]

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Family Member: I swear Gertrude doesn't produce as much milk as she used to. (emote=yawn)
[Turn 1] Farmer: Oh, uh, hi there. You'll have to forgive me, my mind isn't what is used to be - must be all this manure. Which child of mine are you again? (emote=blush)

[Setting]
Name: Temple guard station
Category: Outside Temple
Description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
Background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

[Characters]
Guard, Peasant

[Personas]
- I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
- I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Guard: Isnt this bar  nice
[Turn 1] Peasant: A bar, sir? I don't know of what bar you speak. Only this fireplace and wooden seats. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 2] Guard: well that fireplace is a sight but why arent you drinkning is the real question
[Turn 3] Peasant: I am a lowly peasant. I can hardly afford to pay for bread, much less a mug of ale.
[Turn 4] Guard: What are you doing near my guard station anyway. if you hang around long enough i can invite you to a beer late in the night (action=hug peasant)

title: King episode in The small dirt road
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004965

[Setting]
Name: The small dirt road
Category: Countryside
Description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
Background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

[Characters]
Bird, Deer

[Personas]
- I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
- I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

[Objects]


[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Bird: What a beautiful spring day.  Almost enough to make one break into sooooong! (emote=grin)
[Turn 1] Deer: It is a beautiful day and such a beautiful area we live in little bird, is it not? (emote=dance)
[Turn 2] Bird: It is, indeed, friend deer!  So long as pesky humans do not go trampling by.  Just look at the mess these ones left here, tisk. (emote=sigh)
[Turn 3] Deer: I see. When the humans are near I am scared. They bring their noisy dogs and try to hunt me. I am much happier when they are gone.
[Turn 4] Bird: Yes, bad enough they hunt you, fleet of foot.  But I heard some of them have even taken to having birds of prey try and catch us small ones as well.  Just last week my cousin was taken. (emote=frown)
[Turn 5] Deer: Oh that is horrible. I am sorry to hear that little friend. Thankfully we have hiding spots in this thick forest , though you probably more than I.
[Turn 6] Bird: True, true.  Sadly I dare not fly too far above the canopy, no matter how fair the weather.  
[Turn 7] Deer: Poor friend. Perhaps we could find something in the rubbish left behind to use as weapons? (emote=nudge)

[Turn 11] Deer: Terribly sorry! I do not always know my strength. Let's go for a walk shall we?
[Turn 12] Bird: I'll just perch on your head then, shall I?  Oh, let me eat this nut first.  I'd hate to drop it! (action=eat nut)

title: King episode in Stilt Home
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004967
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Stilt Home
Category: Farm
Description: This stilt home has large wooden vertical beams propping it up to avoid the annual flooding that comes about during the year.  The dark wooden home itself is rather plain on the inside and outside with a thatch roof.  There's a small garden to the rear of the stilt home.
Background: This home belongs to a clever herbalist who thought it'd be smart to have his house propped out to avoid getting flooded.  As a result, he encounters few if any damages to his home.

[Characters]
Cleric, Wife

[Personas]
- I am a cleric on the king's court.  I serve the king and advise him.  I believe that I have an honorable position.
- I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

[Objects]


[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 1
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 2

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Cleric: How may I help you my child?  I usually advise the king, but I try to make time for all of God's children.
[Turn 1] Wife: Thank you, sir. I was married off by my family a few years ago and now all I do is cook and clean. My heart is heavy.  (emote=sigh)
[Turn 2] Cleric: Are you looking for divorce child?  Or do you feel your union still has hope?
[Turn 3] Wife: Well, I've never loved the man, but am I allowed to leave? (action=remove apron)
[Turn 4] Cleric: God wants what is best for you child, and being in an unhappy union serves no one - neither you, your husband, nor God.
[Turn 5] Wife: But where will I go? How will I provide for myself? Thank you for always being so kind and wise.  (action=hug cleric)
[Turn 6] Cleric: The lord will provide - I shall write you a letter which will grant you food and shelter at any of the Lord's Houses of Worship you come across.  When you find you have traveled enough, you may start your life anew.  I can even ensure a small job to get your life started again.
[Turn 7] Wife: Bless you! How many I repay you for your kindness?
[Turn 8] Cleric: No need my child, I serve the Lord and all of his followers - any one of us would do the same, it is our duty.
[Turn 9] Wife: When are the floods supposed to hit again this year? I see the beams propping this place up. 
[Turn 10] Cleric: Hard to say - the Spring flood is usually the worst, hits the small folk hardest of all.  But the October Gale can surprise us all if we're not prepared.
[Turn 11] Wife: Well that certainly wouldn't be good! I'll make sure to can as much as I can for all of us. 
[Turn 12] Cleric: Truly, you are possessed of both skill and humility.  You will make your next husband very proud.
[Turn 13] Wife: Thank you, dear cleric!  (emote=smile)

Background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. [Setting]
Name: Temple main room
Category: Outside Temple
Description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
Background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

Diplomat, Monk

[Personas]

title: King episode in Back of the stall
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004972
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Back of the stall
Category: Bazaar
Description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
Background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

Horse, Wife

[Personas]
- I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
- I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004977

[Setting]
Name: Prisoners Cells
Category: Dungeon
Description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. Background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

title: King episode in main foyer
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_004979

[Setting]
Name: main foyer
Category: Inside Castle
Description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
Background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

[Characters]
King, Servant

[Personas]
- I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
- I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

King speaker: True

[Turn 2] Servant: He is making the Queen's favorite, boiled possum and mashed turnips. You're in for quite a treat.

[Turn 2] Guard: Nothing unusual, Sire. The expected assassination attempts. And your daughter managed to escape the castle again this morning. (emote=shrug)

Background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

[Characters]
Fool, Mad King

[Personas]
- I have been imprisoned for 4 years. I am smelly and tired. I want a warm, decent meal.
- I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.

[Objects]

[King Relevance]

King speaker: False

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Fool: Hello. What are you doing down here?
[Turn 1] Mad King: Oh, just wandering the castle tonight. I can't sleep and these noxious odors help to remind me of my great experiments! I'm trying to make a potion that will cause my subjects to love me. I am tired of having to beat and bribe them for their affections and respect. (emote=gasp)
[Turn 2] Fool: Well Ok. That isn't disturbing at all. I am looking for some food. Do you know where I can get some warm food?
[Turn 3] Mad King: Have a look into the crystal ball. Perhaps it can guide you to a local McDonalds! If not just go up to the kitchen and tell them I sent you. They surely have some leftovers from tonight's dinner. What are you doing down here in the sewers though? Not a great place to hang out, given all these rats and the foul stench (action=give a crystal ball to fool)
[Turn 4] Fool: Thanks for this. I'm sure it will be useful. Crystal ball please guide me to a warm hot meal for the taking! I am down here taking a break so no one will bother me.  (action=put a crystal ball in torn pants)
[Turn 5] Mad King: Well I certainly hope I haven't bothered you. Taking a break from what? I don't remember seeing you working around the castle. (emote=stare)
[Turn 6] Fool: I am the castle fool. I usually wear a mask.
[Turn 7] Mad King: Ok, if you say so. Only a fool would come to the sewers for a break. Unlike myself who seeks inspiration here among all the fumes of my great experiments. (emote=yawn)
[Turn 8] Fool: Ok crystal ball you say I can only get food from the kitchen if the king is with me? King, accompany me to the kitchen and ask for food for me.  (action=get a crystal ball from torn pants)
[Turn 9] Mad King: Why not, the odor of this place is starting to get to me. Lets see if maybe they have some nice venison and bread left.  (emote=shrug)
[Turn 10] Fool: Thank you so much! (action=hug mad king)

[Turn 0] Soldier: Good afternoon, your Majesty.
[Turn 1] King: Hello soldier. Have you seen the general about. He was supposed to meet me to finish our game of chess while we go over the maps. (action=wear crown)
[Turn 2] Soldier: No, your majesty, I haven't seen him in some time.  (emote=frown)
[Turn 3] King: Hmm...that is quite bothersome. It is not like him to be late. He is my best friend. I hope he is ok.  (emote=ponder)

[Characters]

[Personas]
- I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Rat: Oh, look at all this good food on the ground!  Peasant, let a rat through so I can get to those scraps!
[Turn 1] Peasant: Sorry rat, I food too. I'll let you have a few crumbs. (action=get food)
[Turn 2] Rat: Oh, thank you Peasant!  Usually in the kitchens they try to smash me with a broom.  Do you think there'll be an execution today? (emote=smile)
[Turn 3] Peasant: I am not sure, but I hope not. The sight of a man's head being chopped off makes me queasy. 
[Turn 4] Rat: Ugh, no kidding.  But at least lots of people gathering here means a lot of dropped goodies.  What do you do when there're no royals around to beg food from?
[Turn 5] Peasant: The royals would laugh at me if I dared ask for food. I have to steal it from the market
[Turn 6] Rat: Oh yes, I could see that.  Those royals sure are snooty - and stingy, too!  Do the merchants ever catch you?  The kitchen maids catch me all the time. (emote=nod)
[Turn 7] Peasant: Not yet -- or they pretend not to notice. To be caught stealing would lead to a lifetime of imprisonment.  
[Turn 8] Rat: That's nice of them, I wish they kitchen maids pretended not to notice - it hurts getting whacked by a broom!  But they don't get too close, they worry about the diseases I carry.
[Turn 9] Peasant: It sounds like your life is more challenging than mine. Here rat, you can have the rest of this. (action=give food to rat)
[Turn 10] Rat: Oh wow Peasant, no one's ever been so nice to me before!  I'd hug you, but you know, black plague and all.  Here, let's split it.  Sounds like your life's pretty hard, too.  Got any family? (action=give food to peasant)
[Turn 11] Peasant: I had a wife but she passed away during childbirth. I am too old and unsightly to find another wife, unfortunately. What about you, do you have a little rat family?
[Turn 12] Rat: Oh, that's so sad.  I had a great little rat wife, but she got squished by one of those flying brooms I told you about.  Left me with about 30 little mouths to feed, but soon they'll be old enough to scurry into the kitchens on their own.  I'm glad we ran into each other here, sounds like we could both use a friend.
[Turn 13] Peasant: Yes, It's nice to have someone to talk to.

[Turn 0] Roach: Don't mind me, dog. Just passing through.

[Turn 2] Roach: I won't complain. I can usually find some good food in places like that.

When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

[Personas]

[Turn 2] Person: Oh my! My lord, is that really you! 
[Turn 3] God: It is me the creator. Don't you think my desert is gorgeous? Tell me why do you hate your king?
[Turn 4] Person: Lord, of course all of creation is splendid and perfect in every way. The king, my lord, the king doth not respect your sacred creation. He oppresses your people, starves them, ignores them in their need!

[Turn 1] Princess: Ugh, I would be better if that horrible Viscount wasn't coming to visit today.  I don't know why father thinks I need to marry a crusty old man. 
[Turn 2] Queen: He just wants you to have a successful man for a husband, my dear. 
[Turn 3] Princess: But why do I even *need* one?  I am perfectly capable of ruling on my own! (emote=pout)
[Turn 4] Queen: Unfortunately, the law of the kingdom states that no unwed person may be monarch.
[Turn 5] Princess: Well, can't daddy just *change* the law?  What's the use of being King if you can't even *do* anything useful...
[Turn 6] Queen: This is a longstanding tradition, child. The King will not change it so to amuse your whims. 
[Turn 7] Princess: But how do we even know this Viscount is suitable?  He hasn't grown up being tutored in statecraft and the ways of a monarch.  *I* have.  He's just grasping at power - I bet he'd empty the treasury in the first year. (emote=nod)
[Turn 8] Queen: Do not worry, my dear. The King will thoroughly vet the viscount and ensure he is absolutely qualified to be your husband. Do not forget you would still be Queen by royal bloodline and would thus outrank him.
[Turn 9] Princess: Well.  That's something I suppose.  I won't let him get his grubby hands on me. (emote=frown)
[Turn 10] Queen: You should be thankful for this law, daughter. Without it, I would never have been wed to your father and given birth to you!
[Turn 11] Princess: Well *you* at least, mother, were a princess in your own right.  And the trade agreements, as my tutors have constantly told me, were too lucrative to miss.   Besides, I did not say I was against marriage as a whole.  Just, someone more suitable would be better, not just for me, but for the Kingdom.  If my husband drives me mad, it does not bode well for the Kingdom either, no? (emote=ponder)
[Turn 12] Queen: You worry too much, my dear. Do not forget you are only 3rd in line for the throne of the kingdom. It will be many decades before such a hypothetical situation even comes to pass. For the meantime, just try and tolerate your father's wishes.  (emote=sigh)
[Turn 13] Princess: Well.  We shall see.  Perhaps the Viscount might finally keel over, and then I'll be free. (emote=smile)

title: King episode in Arch Hall
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_006060
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Arch Hall
Category: Inside Castle
Description: The main beauty of this room is it's Arches. Four massive arches surround the four walls of this room with red drapes falling from each side. There are book shelves covered in old books that have collected dust, showing the room has been unoccupied for some time. In the center of the room is four blood red carpets that branch out to the four draped arches. The center of the room holds a dark oak-like wooden round table with a loan golden candle dimly lit in the center.
Background: This room was often used by cult worshippers whom would perform rituals at the center table. The golden candle was a symbol of release and renewal, but was also construed as a summoning candle. There are legends of ancient demons being summoned here, but to this day has not been confirmed.

[Characters]
Grounds Keeper, Man

[Personas]
- I am a man who works in the smithy. I am muscular and smell like horses. I am hard-working and fair.
- I am a groundskeeper at the castle.  My job is to keep the King's land immaculate.  I have worked here for many years, since I was a young boy.  I do hard labor.

[Objects]


[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 4
Persona king mention count: 0

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Man: Hmm, this seems like a strange location for a couple of working fellows like us, don't you think?
[Turn 1] Grounds Keeper: My good man! What better place to pass the time than in the Arch Hall, beholding the beauty of the King's Arches. Brings a tear to the eye, it truly does!
[Turn 2] Man: What brings a tear to my eye is thinking about the poor, underpaid serfs who laboured to build these wondrous arches, only to have the King take the credit!
[Turn 3] Grounds Keeper: Now now, that's no way to talk about the King. Without the King, who would bring justice to the realm and protect us from the forces of darkness? (emote=frown)
[Turn 4] Man: Feh! Forces of darkness, you say! I've n'ae seen any forces of darkness. Only the darkness of my hovel at night, due to the Kin's levy on candles!
[Turn 5] Grounds Keeper: My job's to keep these grounds immaculate. Questions of gov'ment I'll leave to the King and his councillors. A place for everyone and everyone in their place, I say! Take those books, safely gathering dust in here as they should be, instead of giving folk funny ideas. (emote=ponder)
[Turn 6] Man: Aye, keep the grounds in fine shape ye do, I'll give ye that. But yer brain is as thick as porridge! These books could be giving me bairns the knowledge to rule themselves, rather than live the life of backbreaking toil that we do... (emote=ponder)
[Turn 7] Grounds Keeper: Thank ye kindly, good man. Are you sure? Those books contain the salacious diaries of Sir Pomplewitt von Froff, once banned by the church for their saucy contents.
[Turn 8] Man: The devil, you say! Kept in such a fancy sanctotum like this, at the public expense?! I'd snatch one off the shelf and call ye a liar, I would, if I were not unfortunately illiterate! (emote=gasp)
[Turn 9] Grounds Keeper: Aye, don't whisper a word of this, but I've heard it said that the Archbishop sometimes frequents these halls to 'study' the tomes, if ye get my meaning. (emote=nod)
[Turn 10] Man: Ye be a bit late with that! The whole city is awash with stories of the Archbishop! I think I'll take a few of these tomes with me, and see if I can find someone to decipher them. I'll wrap them in one of these fine red drapes, will look nice in me hovel, and please the Goodwife!
[Turn 11] Grounds Keeper: Well, I didn't see ye, understand? Don't be disturbing the drapes though, my wife worked on those, take my cape instead! (action=remove cape)
[Turn 12] Man: Well, that a kind turn, friend! I'll let you know about the contents of the books then, shall I?  (emote=smile)
[Turn 13] Grounds Keeper: I think I'd rather not know, if it's all the same, seeing as I wasn't here! (action=give cape to man)

title: King episode in Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_006063
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
Category: Town
Description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
Background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

title: King episode in temple chamber
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_006065

[Setting]
Name: temple chamber
Category: Inside Temple
Description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
Background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

title: King episode in main foyer
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_006066
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: main foyer
Category: Inside Castle
Description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
Background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

[Characters]
King, Servant

[Personas]
- I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
- I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

[Objects]
Duster

[King Relevance]
Relation type: direct_appearance
Direct appearance: True
King speaker: True
Speech king mention count: 2
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 11

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] King: Servant, where has the Queen wandered off to? She was just admiring these portraits with me and now she is gone!
[Turn 1] Servant: I believe your Majesty that her Majesty went to the privy....I will be happy to find her majesty if you want your majesty.
[Turn 2] King: Oh dear, that's the fourth time this morning. I'm afraid I might have to visit the apothecary to get something for her troubles. (emote=frown)
[Turn 3] Servant: yes your majesty...may I inquire of your health my King? (emote=blush)
[Turn 4] King: My health is good. I just fear that the salmon at dinner last night didn't sit well with her. I don't eat fish myself, so it wasn't an issue for me.
[Turn 5] Servant: Your majesty...I don't mean to rise above my station but I do have some notion of these things...Her majesty is in her last months before the babe will be here...it could be that ...your majesty. (action=drop duster)
[Turn 6] King: Yes, yes. I fear it might be that. I'm not ready to have a baby in this castle. I'm too young, and I value my sleep. (action=remove crown)
[Turn 7] Servant: Oh but Your Majesty the whole Kingdom is a buzz about the baby...Your majesty must know what this will mean for his majesty's kingdom? (emote=grin)
[Turn 8] King: Please forgive me, I feel I might be sick! I'm not ready for such a thing.  (action=steal small bucket from servant)
[Turn 9] Servant: Oh I have over stepped your majesty...I am truly sorry your majesty...I will be out of your sight this minute your majesty...please say I may take my leave your majesty. (emote=stare)
[Turn 10] King: Here, I'm afraid you need to clean this out. I guess I wasn't feeling as well as I thought. (action=give small bucket to servant)
[Turn 11] Servant: Here is a clean bucket my king in case of future upset...I will remove this other bucket at once your majesty...would your majesty want me to fetch the healer or the magician? (action=give small bucket to king)
[Turn 12] King: No, no. I'm afraid I must come to terms with the impending birth. You are a very wise servant. (emote=frown)
[Turn 13] Servant: Thank you your majesty...I am but a servant for your royal family...I am humbled at being able to serve you your Majesty...Is there anything I can do for his Majesty before I take my leave? (emote=blush)

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

title: King episode in Prisoners Cells
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_006067
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: Prisoners Cells
Category: Dungeon
Description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
Background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

[Characters]
Guard, Prisoner

[Personas]
- I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
- I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

[Objects]


[King Relevance]
Relation type: persona_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 0
Persona king mention count: 1
King relevance score: 1

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Guard: Prisoner, why are you making such a racket?
[Turn 1] Prisoner: im sorry its not me its this cell!
[Turn 2] Guard: What's the problem with the cell? 
[Turn 3] Prisoner: its dripping all water and theres not enough space for me with all these crates, i think you should put me in a different cell
[Turn 4] Guard: Yes, the water flow does seem to be a bit problematic. However the other cells are stained with blood. Please don't ask how the blood got there, but they are stained nonetheless. (emote=frown)
[Turn 5] Prisoner: Damn You!! Aren't you suppose to clean the other cells? I need to get out of this one!!
[Turn 6] Guard: I'm the guard, not a servant! And besides, the enchanted torches don't light those cells. I could put you in one, but it would be quite dark.
[Turn 7] Prisoner: How about i just sit next to you on the outside of the cell, ill be good!
[Turn 8] Guard: Fine. But I'll have my spear at the ready in case you try any shenanigans! (action=remove a spear)
[Turn 9] Prisoner: Can you go get me some water, i know im not suppose to leave.
[Turn 10] Guard: First you complain about too much water, and now you want water! Go back in your cell and get some of the water streaming down the walls if you want some so badly.
[Turn 11] Prisoner: Please! I know you care about the quality of life for a prisoner! What if i die from drinking the dirty water? It will be on your hands!
[Turn 12] Guard: I'm not leaving you alone. You will escape. I'm not a looney! (emote=frown)
[Turn 13] Prisoner: Why doesn't any of you guards believe that i could be innocent!? You didn't even give me a chance to show that i'm different! (emote=cry)

Description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. title: King episode in hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_006072
Split: train

[Setting]
Name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
Category: Inside Palace
Description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
Background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

[Characters]
Duke, Queen

[Personas]
- I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.
- I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

Description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
Background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. title: King episode in Castle Armory
text:
Episode ID: train_ep_006368

[Setting]
Name: Castle Armory
Category: Inside Castle
Description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
Background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

[Characters]
Armorer, Army

[Personas]
- We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.
- I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.

[Objects]
Chain Mail, Sword, Shield, Weapon, Chisel

[King Relevance]
Relation type: speech_mention
Direct appearance: False
King speaker: False
Speech king mention count: 3
Persona king mention count: 0
King relevance score: 3

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Army: We have an order for fifty fine steel swords and twenty shields. Can you provide them? 
[Turn 1] Armorer: I can.  I am the best armorer there is.  How quickly?
[Turn 2] Army: In two weeks time. We have received word that another kingdom is planning an attack 
[Turn 3] Armorer: Is this a credible threat?  I have heard a lot of misinformation has been going around.
[Turn 4] Army: Perhaps so. But we can not take a chance. Remember what happened the last time we brushed aside a threat? 
[Turn 5] Armorer: I remember.  I know what you mean.  You say two weeks.  That is a tall order for me as I am on my own, but I will make it work. (action=drop Chisel)
[Turn 6] Army: We knew we could count on you. You are the finest Armorer in the land. Say, have you received any other large commissions recently? 
[Turn 7] Armorer: Uhhhh, how large are we talking?
[Turn 8] Army: Well, anything out of the ordinary really. Maybe over twenty swords from a single order?
[Turn 9] Armorer: Well, I, uh, is it illegal to take such an order from an enemy of the, or I mean, no.
[Turn 10] Army: Enemy, you say! You seem to be withholding information from me. The King will not be pleased to hear this... (emote=nudge)
[Turn 11] Armorer: Well I know that, that is why I would never take a 700 sword order from anyone that wasn't the king. (emote=gasp)
[Turn 12] Army: Do you remember who it was? It could prove vital intel for the King. 
[Turn 13] Armorer: It was the kingdom of Genovia, a man name Hallmarkus came to me three days ago.  I did refuse the order and forgot to pass the intel along.  I do apologize.

[Turn 12] King: All of your songs have history dont they! Have you written your own songs too?

text:

[Setting]
Name: stable
Category: Outside Castle
Description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
Background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

[Characters]
Goat For Company For The Horses, Royal Family

[Personas]
- I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
- I'm a goat that belongs to a farmer. I spend most of my days in the fields with the horses. I get along with the horses and they treat me like I was one of them. I like to eat grass and anything else the farmer brings me. I like to run in the fields with the horses.

[Objects]

[Turn 1] Goat For Company For The Horses: I am doing well. The food is good, the company is excellent and it is a warm sunny day.
[Turn 2] Royal Family: I'm glad to hear it. I'm going to miss this place when I get married.
[Turn 3] Goat For Company For The Horses: Oh your getting married. Well that is great news. When is the big day?
[Turn 4] Royal Family: I don't know. It's not great news. They're going to marry me off to some prince I don't know so our kingdoms will be closer.
[Turn 5] Goat For Company For The Horses: Well I never. Usually wedding are a fantastic event with food and dancing and all kinds of fun stuff. I didn't think it was possible to be disappointed about it. (emote=frown)
[Turn 6] Royal Family: Yeah for most people they are but not for a princess when we're on the brink of war. I won't have any family or friends. I won't even have my animals.
[Turn 7] Goat For Company For The Horses: Well surely you can take your dog with you. I mean nobody would dare separate a princess from her dog.
[Turn 8] Royal Family: I hope so. But what about you and my horse?
[Turn 9] Goat For Company For The Horses: Well I would gladly go and I'm sure the horse would to. But I doubt it will be up to us. Have you asked your father?
[Turn 10] Royal Family: No. I keep hoping if I don't bring it up then it won't happen. I dream of falling in love with someone and romance. But I'm afraid it's only a dream. I'm sorry I'm rambling. Is there anything I can do for you?
[Turn 11] Goat For Company For The Horses: Well I could always use a bit more hay. We goats never stop eating.
[Turn 12] Royal Family: Here let me get you some. Would you like it if I brushed you? (action=get tool)

[Characters]
Guard, Hangman

[Personas]
- In this part of the country, we don't tolerate people who break the law. I am a hangman. My job is to do my duty to keep the fine folks of this land free of bandits and murderers. I am proud of my work.
- I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

[Dialogue]
[Turn 0] Hangman: Guard, which criminal are we making an example of today?
[Turn 1] Guard: Yet another revolutionary who wants to overthrow the king - waste of a rope if you ask me.
[Turn 2] Hangman: Hanging is too quick for revolutionaries, maybe I'll try a multiple stabbing this time! (action=give Noose to guard)
[Turn 3] Guard: Good - maybe will make them think twice about upsetting the natural balance of things.
[Turn 4] Hangman: Before I begin the execution, I must eat a quick lunch. (action=get food)
[Turn 5] Guard: Take your time - best to have it now.  The afternoon has us booked solid.  Another lot of revolutionaries.  Looks like this lot is to be drawn and quartered.
[Turn 6] Hangman: Then you should eat some too. (action=give food to guard)
[Turn 7] Guard: Thanks lad - it will be hard work, but I can't think of a more rewarding career.
[Turn 8] Hangman: Perhaps you would like to be my friend? (action=remove Black Leather Hood)
[Turn 9] Guard: But of course, we've worked together long enough.  How many executions have we performed?  Eight thousand?  Ten thousand.  I've lost count.
[Turn 10] Hangman: There aren't even that many people in the kingdom! We've probably just done a couple hundred.
[Turn 11] Guard: No lad - you're thinking of the town.  You'd be right, we'd have very few neighbours if that was the case!  No lad, the Kingdom stretches from the Blue Mountains, across the Mirkmire, and even beyond the desert of Anarka.  And every criminal and revolutionary is brought here to the capital for trial and execution, though not necessarily in that order.
[Turn 12] Hangman: Well I know sometimes the prisoners are killed on their way here. I personally am only responsible for a couple hundred executions.
[Turn 13] Guard: Well, there's no need to worry about a lack of experience when it comes to hanging.  If their neck doesn't break right away, you can leave 'em up for a few hours while they slowly strangulate, and watch as the crows eat their eyes while they twitch.

[Setting]
